new_roles.title: Director, Farm Operations
new_roles.description:
**Job no:** 564177
 
**Work type:** Management (MPP)
 
**Location:** Pomona
 
**Categories:** MPP, Administrative, At-Will, Full Time, On-site (work in-person at business location)

**Type of Appointment:** Full-Time, At-Will
 
 
**Job Classification:** Administrator II
 
 
**Anticipated Hiring Range:** Up to $10,833 per month (Commensurate with skills and qualifications)
 
 
**Work Schedule:** 8:00am-5:00pm Mon - Fri, possible weekend 
 
 
 
**THE DEPARTMENT:**
 
 
The College of Agriculture is one of five agricultural colleges in California. It is the sole provider of comprehensive agricultural programs focusing on the needs of the $1 trillion Southern California economy and its 22 million people. The College provides a unique integrative approach to agricultural education that recognizes the strong disciplinary interdependencies related to professional orientation and culture, basic societal needs, lifestyles, and social and environmental responsibility. It is well positioned to meet the expanding demand for qualified graduates in highly specialized fields within the agricultural, food, fiber, and animal industries. The farming facilities, Farm Store and AGRlscapes support the educational mission of the College of Agriculture and are vital to the College's legacy and excellent reputation.
 
 
**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Operational Leadership and Strategic Direction

* In coordination with the Dean, Associate Dean, and appropriate college faculty, provide operational leadership and strategic direction for the Huntley College’s agricultural and animal operations in support of the college and university missions.
* Responsible for operational and financial planning, implementation and control in a fiscally viable, legally compliant and environmentally responsible manner.
* Function as the HEERA manager and provide overall supervision of state and foundation members of staff plus part-time student employees.

Fiscal Responsibilities:

* Develop, plan, manage, and monitor an $8 million operations budget.
* Align resource allocation with College of Ag goals and objectives and provision of services necessary to provide high-quality Ag products in a safe, effective learning environment.
* Oversee the effective and sustainable use of over 600 acres of field crops, tree and vine, horticulture, and pasture lands located on main CPP campus, Spadra Ranch, Pine Tree Ranch (Santa Paula), and AGRlscapes.
* Plan, coordinate, and manage production of over 60 different agricultural commodities to include greenhouse hydroponic fruit, vegetables and ornamental plants. Responsible for the safety training and documentation for all faculty, staff, and students involved in operating equipment, vehicles, and any related farm tools and machinery or pesticides.
* Creates and maintains partnerships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Educates campus and community constituents regarding agriculture and functions in a way as to foster Development and Alumni relations regarding Agriculture at Cal Poly Pomona.
* Manages a farm crew of approximately 10 State and Foundation employees and an additional 50 student workers.
* Responsible for the safety training and documentation for all faculty, staff and students involved in operating equipment, vehicles and any related farm tools and machinery or pesticides.
* Prepares performance reviews for assigned staff.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's Degree - Required fields include: agricultural science, agricultural management, agribusiness, agricultural business, agricultural economics, business administration, finance, or a closely related field is required. Candidates with degrees in business administration or finance must also demonstrate substantial experience managing agricultural or livestock operations.
* A Pest Control Advisor (PCA) license or the ability to obtain a PCA license within 6 months
* Driver's license, valid and in-state
* A minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience managing agricultural, farming, or livestock operations, including experience with modern agricultural practices, personnel supervision, budgeting, equipment, and safety.
* Candidates selected for this position will be required to complete a credit check before appointment.
* Demonstrated accomplishments in agricultural production, farm management, or related operations are required.
* A thorough knowledge of the planning, implementation, and control of sustainable agriculture/ animal husbandry operations.
* Knowledge of all laws and regulations related to safe and environmentally responsible agriculture.
* Familiarity with requirements to maintain organic certification.
* Knowledge of technologies, methods, practices, and procedures used in modern agriculture, personnel and financial management.
* A thorough knowledge of efficient production of field crops, tree and vine, horticulture and pasture lands to include all equipment involved;
* Knowledge of safety and regulations related to safe and environmentally responsible agriculture.
 

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* An earned master’s degree in agriculture, agricultural business, agricultural management, business administration, or a science-related field.
* A Certified Crop Adviser (CCA) credential, or the ability and appropriate coursework to obtain the credential.
* Conversational or professional proficiency in Spanish.
* Experience managing diverse agricultural operations, including field crops, orchards or vineyards, horticulture, pasture, and livestock.
* Experience with farm equipment, irrigation systems, agricultural facilities, and capital improvement planning.
* Experience establishing and maintaining field research trials.
* Experience working in a higher education or academic agricultural environment, including coordinating with faculty and campus partners to support teaching, research, and student learning.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, communicate, and work collaboratively with employees, students, faculty, campus partners, and individuals from diverse backgrounds.
* Demonstrated success supervising employees and students.
* A record of accomplishment in fiscal responsibility and budget management
 

**Benefits**
 
 
At California State University (CSU), we prioritize the health, growth, and success of our employees. Our benefits program reflects our commitment to your overall well-being.

To be eligible for full benefits, employees must be appointed at least half-time (.50 FTE) with an appointment lasting more than six months and one day. Benefits eligibility and offerings may vary based on appointment type, classification, and applicable collective bargaining agreement. Eligible employees may have access to a comprehensive benefits package that can include:

* **Paid Time Off:** Up to 24 vacation days per year, based on employee group and/or length of service; 14 paid holidays; and 12 sick days annually with unlimited accrual.
* **Health Coverage:** A variety of medical, dental, and vision plans.
* **Retirement Plans:** Participation in the CalPERS defined benefit plan, along with voluntary savings options such as 403(b), 401(k), and 457 plans.
* **Educational Benefits:** Tuition fee waiver programs for eligible employees; dependent eligibility varies by employee group and bargaining unit.
* **Employee Assistance Program (EAP):** Confidential counseling and support services for employees and their families.
* **Additional Benefits:** Wellness programs, professional development opportunities, and insurance options including life, disability, and pet insurance.

Candidates are encouraged to review the appropriate CSU Employee Benefits Summary for details specific to their position.

Additionally, the CSU Total Compensation Calculator is available to help prospective employees understand the full value of the CSU benefits package and how it complements base salary.
 
 
**Out of State Work**
 
 
The California State University (CSU) system is a network of twenty-three public universities providing access to a quality education through the support of California taxpayers. Part of CSU’s mission is to prepare educated, responsible individuals to contribute to California’s schools, economy, culture, and future. As an agency of the State of California, the CSU’s business operations almost exclusively reside within California. The CSU Out-of-State Employment Policy prohibits hiring employees to perform CSU-related work outside California. For more information, go to the California State University Out-of-State Employment Policy.
 
 
**Background Check**
 
 
Cal Poly Pomona will make a conditional offer of employment to final job candidates, pending the satisfactory completion of a background check (including a criminal records check). The conditional offer of employment may be rescinded if the background check reveals disqualifying information, and/or it is discovered that the candidate knowingly withheld or falsified information. In determining the suitability of the candidate for the position, Cal Poly Pomona will give an individualized assessment to any information that the applicant submits for consideration regarding the criminal conviction history such as the nature, gravity and recency of the conviction, the candidate’s conduct, performance or rehabilitation efforts since the conviction and the nature of the job applied for. For more information, go to the California State University Background Check Policy.
 
 
**Education Code 89521 Requirements**
 
 
Applicants will be required to disclose whether they have received a final administrative decision or final judicial decision determining that they have committed sexual harassment within the last 7 years only after a determination is made that they meet the minimum qualifications for the position, and before an offer of employment is extended. Applicants who reach the final stages of the application process must also sign a release form that authorizes the release of information by the applicant’s current and/or former employers to the CSU concerning any substantiated allegations of misconduct.
 
 
**CSU Classification Salary Range**
 
 
The CSU Classification Standards for this position are located on the CSU Classification Standards website. The CSU Salary Schedule is located on the CSU Salary Schedule website. The classification salary range for this position according to the respective skill level is: minimum $5,053 and maximum $16,221 per month. Please refer to the anticipated hiring range for the appropriate salary rate for this particular position.
 
 
**Employment Eligibility Verification**
 
 
Cal Poly Pomona hires only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. For more information, go the I-9 Acceptable Documents website.
 
 
**University Driving Requirement**
 
 
Positions that require driving for university business by using a personal or state vehicle must comply with the Authorized University Driver Policy. Driving records are monitored and evaluated by the Risk Management Department. The Risk Management Department evaluates a good driving report based on the following criteria. The driver must: 1. new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Job Summary**

The position of **Plant Manager** is responsible for directing, coordinating, and managing the overall facility operation in conjunction with the customer’s production requirements. Ensure facility production objectives are achieved at the lowest cost consistent with IATF16949 quality requirements. Delegate production leadership responsibilities to achieve the desired objectives set forth in the corporate business plan while maintaining compliance to Federal, State, and Local Safety and Environmental regulations and laws.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plant Operation
 + Coordinate with the operations manager in the execution of production schedules based on sales requirements and plant capacity.
 + Coordinate and communicate with leadership team and department managers in meeting production goals while focusing on continuous improvement and cost reduction initiatives.
 + Schedule manufacturing activities based on customer releases to minimize inventory.
 + Ensure orders are released in chronological order (FIFO) unless circumstances dictate a change in customer needs.
 + Ensure all “work in process” is properly tagged in accordance with procedures and instructions.
 + Receive and review daily shift reports from leadership team and address areas of concern.
* Ensure the production floor is well equipped, well maintained and efficiently designed
 + Per the IATF16949 requirements, ensure that production floor is equipped with proper work instructions and procedures to carry out production activities.
 + Ensure properly maintained equipment and appropriate trained personnel are available to carry out these activities.
 + Work with operations, program management, and process engineering teams to ensure new programs and process changes are implemented within designated launch plan requirements.
 + Support new program launches and engineer changes that may include floor layouts, staffing, quality and/or tooling requirements.
 + Provide continuous review of departmental processes to improve overall efficiencies.
 + Ensure facility management, making sure the facility meets all production operation requirements.
* Adherence to established policies, processes and procedures
 + Work with leadership team to enforce written policies and procedures to ensure consistency and fairness while maintaining a healthy and safe work environment.
 + Review and approve recommendations of subordinates in matters of position changes and promotions.
 + Work with leadership team to identify and record any issues relating to process failures, policy or procedure violations, or quality system failures
 + When and where required, assist leadership team with attendance management, performance management and corrective action of employees.
* Assist with implementation and compliance of all health, safety, environmental and quality control plans
 + Work with quality department to ensure adherence to the IATF16949 quality standards and corporate quality best practices.
 + Review and disposition of nonconforming products.
 + Assist in providing solutions to prevent reoccurrence.
 + Ensure consistency with implementation and adherence of the company health, safety and environmental policies and processes.
 + Ensure compliance with Federal, State and Local regulatory requirements such as OSHA, EPA, etc.
 + Be visible, assume leadership, and assist in developing and initiating an effective health and safety attitude. Participate and initiate in continuous safety training.

**Qualifications**

* Education
 + Minimum Required: Associates Degree or Technical Accreditation
 + Preferred: Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management, Administration or equivalent
* Experience
 + Minimum Required: 5+ years working in a production environment
 + 2+ years working in a manager or supervisory role in manufacturing/production environment
 + Preferred: 5+ years working in a managerial role in a manufacturing/production environment
* Must have and maintain a valid Driver’s License
* Strong technical background and a general understanding of a manufacturing/production process
* Fluent in English (verbal, reading, writing)
* Must be team-oriented and have excellent communication, organizational and computer literacy skills
* Requires a high level of professionalism and strong work ethic
* Preferred: Familiarity with TS16949 or IATF 16949, Quality Audits, and Environmental Management System and OSHA Requirements

**Working Conditions**

The following working conditions are present or expected on a daily basis:

* Manufacturing/production floor environment with a presence on the production floor required for at least 50% of daily work time.
* Frequent exposure to industrial manufacturing, automotive vehicles, weather elements, chemicals and robotics.
* Personal protective equipment must be worn at all times on the production floor.

**IMPORTANT NOTE**

The organization reserves the right to change, amend or disuse this job description at any time. This document is intended to provide an overview of the required responsibilities and qualifications.

#### **Education**

Preferred

* Associates or better

#### **Licenses & Certifications**

Required

* Drivers License

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

new_roles.title: Plant General Manager
new_roles.description:
At Cavco Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ CVCO), our 7000 team members are at the heart of everything we do. We design and produce quality, affordable factory-built homes. We are also a leading producer of park model RVs, vacation cabins and factory-built commercial structures. In addition to providing competitive pay and benefits, we provide opportunities for development and upward mobility, while investing in the communities we serve. Our values are our foundation. We’re constantly striving to diversify our teams to ensure we have the best and brightest talent. We’re deeply committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace where each person can contribute.

 

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Cavco is seeking an experienced and strategic leader within the manufactured housing industry to oversee and direct overall plant operations. The General Manager is responsible for ensuring business objectives are achieved professionally, ethically, and in accordance with company policy and core values. The General Manager has a responsibility to influence core values by demonstrating them. Safety and Quality will be emphasized as priority over throughput and demonstrated in business planning through measurable annual results. Additionally, the General Manager is responsible for decisions which influence operational results including but not limited to profitability, plant direction, product mix and pricing. The General Manager has the management responsibility and authority for the total operation of an individual plant. He/she is accountable for results, development of KPIs, and continuous improvement. Relocation assistance may be offered for qualified candidates willing to relocate for the role.

 

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

The General Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and compliance of the plant. Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

* **Asset Protection & Controls**
* Ensure all company assets are properly safeguarded and that effective internal controls are established and maintained.
* **Quality Assurance**
* Ensure the plant consistently produces code-compliant, high-quality homes. Conduct periodic inspections of plant output to validate adherence to quality standards.
* **Business Planning & Execution**
* Collaborate with department heads to develop the annual business plan narrative. Ensure operations are aligned with and meet business plan objectives on a daily, weekly, monthly, and annual basis.
* **Regulatory Compliance**
* Maintain full compliance with all local, state, and federal laws and regulations, including those related to product construction, employee health and safety, and recordkeeping.
* **Team Leadership & Development**
* Ensure employees are competent and aligned with company core values. Conduct annual performance reviews for direct reports and administer compensation fairly and equitably based on performance.
* **Customer Engagement**
* Actively cultivate and maintain strong customer relationships. Regularly visit customers to ensure satisfaction and that company operating objectives are being met.
* **Legal & Risk Management**
* Coordinate with the Regional Vice President (RVP) and Cavco Compliance Department regarding any potential or actual legal matters, including service-related issues. Promptly report and forward any legal documents received for proper handling and recordkeeping.
* **Financial Performance & Accountability**
* Review monthly budget versus actual performance with department heads to ensure alignment and maximize profitability. Identify issues, implement corrective actions, and ensure appropriate follow-up.
* **Leadership & Culture**
* Guide, coach, and motivate team members to achieve business plan objectives. Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high performance.
* **Process Improvement**
* Establish high expectations through strong processes across all areas of management. Focus on improving processes before addressing personnel changes.
* **P&L Management**
* Manage plant profit and loss performance to meet or exceed budget expectations. Understand and optimize the impact of product mix, pricing, and specifications on financial results.
* **Capital Planning**
* Collaborate with department heads to identify capital expenditure needs and develop supporting documentation for investments in systems, equipment, and processes that drive continuous improvement.

 

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in the manufactured housing or related industry required.
* Proven leadership and supervisory experience required.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and support multiple teams in consistently achieving production goals.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, including the ability to support, motivate, and develop team members. Must demonstrate empathy, openness to feedback, and willingness to both provide and receive direction.
* Demonstrated capability to coach and develop people leaders, including functional managers, with a focus on building their ability to lead, coach, and develop their own teams.
* Ability to successfully pass a pre-employment drug screening.
* Demonstrated flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

new_roles.title: Aggregate Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Why Join Our Team?**

At Quikrete, we foster a positive and collaborative work environment where teamwork and cooperation are at the forefront. As a Plant Manager, you will be the driving force behind directing and supervising manufacturing operations at our plant, ensuring the highest level of product quality while optimizing production efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

**What We Offer:**

* **Work-Life Balance:** We understand the importance of achieving your professional goals without compromising your personal life.
* **Career Growth:** Join an industry leader renowned for world-class design, manufacturing, sourcing, and distribution. This is an opportunity to propel your career forward.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** We provide a comprehensive benefits package with customizable options that meet your needs and those of your family.

**About the Role:**

* As a Plant Manager, you will be responsible for:
* Provide leadership and direction to a team of 15-20 employees. This includes selection, development, and evaluation of personnel to ensure a technically competent and highly motivated workforce.
* Oversee the entire manufacturing process, from receipt of materials to shipping. You will utilize our facilities, equipment, and personnel to achieve the highest level of product production while ensuring safety and quality standards are met at the lowest possible cost.
* Develop and maintain high plant standards of safety and work conditions, administer safety programs, and ensure compliance with all safety regulations, including stormwater tests and Pollution Protection Plans.
* Effectively communicate organizational policies and procedures and provide daily direction to various staff functions, including production scheduling, administration, inventory management, order process, and transportation.
* Possess a deep understanding of all manufacturing processes and production equipment.
* Analyze monthly metrics related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and inventory.
* Stay current with Interstate Commerce Commission and Department of Transportation regulations, as well as customer and government agency specifications.
* Coordinate directly with internal and external customers on orders, routes, specifications, pricing, and shipping to ensure the production of high-quality products in line with profit goals and strategies.
* Ensure all quality procedures are adhered to and documented in compliance with company policies.
* Maintain proper inventory levels to support the local market and make necessary adjustments as required.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5 years of supervisory or leadership experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Operating Systems.
* Broad knowledge of business functions, including safety, quality, production operations, accounting, inventory management, cost control/profit and loss management, and shipping.
* Exceptional problem-solving skills and a results-oriented mindset.
* Broad technical knowledge of product and production methods.
* If you are a seasoned leader with a track record of success in manufacturing operations, possess a deep understanding of safety and quality standards, and are looking for a new challenge, we encourage you to apply for the Plant Manager position. Your expertise will be instrumental in maintaining and improving our production processes.

**Ready to Apply?**

The process is simple. Click on the “apply” button to get started. Good luck!

#QKAG

QUIKRETE® is an equal opportunity employer committed to developing a workforce with well-qualified individuals without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, citizenship status, status with regard to public assistance or any other characteristic/status protected by law. QUIKRETE® is a drug-free workplace and conducts pre-employment testing as a condition of employment. If you are unable to apply online due to a disability, contact the QUIKRETE® Recruiting team at *accommodationsforhiring@quikrete.com*.

new_roles.title: EW Operations Engineering Director
new_roles.description:
**Job Description** 
We are seeking a highly strategic and technically accomplished EW Operations Engineering Director with strong Hardware, Systems, and RF design experience, to bridge the gap between advance systems development and factory production. This executive-level role requires a deeply experienced leader who understands product requirements and performance to oversee the complete Life Cycle Management (LCM) of complex hardware ensuring that highly sophisticated Digital and RF Designs seamlessly transition from design environments into full scale production.
 
The ideal candidate possesses deep domain expertise in Electronic Warfare (EW) systems and acts as the ultimate authority and liaison between Systems/Hardware Designs engineering and Manufacturing Operations. You will champion “Left Shift” engineering philosophies-refining, shaping, and validating hardware configurations long before they reach the factory floor to optimize, yield, efficiency, and electrical and mechanical compliances
 
•**Key Responsibilities**
 
•**Strategic Operations and Factory Leadership**
 
•Production Lifecycle Management: Own the end-to-end process governing how critical hardware is moved, staged, and executes across factories of record.
 
•Factory of record integration: Maintain comprehensive understanding of the People, Build, Equipment limitations, Operational Rules and technical boundaries to align design tolerances with factory capabilities.
 
•Operational Compliance: Author, Develop, and Maintain the Manufacturing Design Rules Documents in collaboration with the process engineers and subject matter experts (SME). Establish robust mitigation strategies for Non-compliant or ‘Red” technical requirements
 
•Technology Insertion: Evaluate, introduce, and integrate new manufacturing and test technologies and evolving factory capabilities to continually improve product lines.
 
•**Cross-Functional Engineering Liaison & Governance**
 
•Design-to-Production: Acts as the strategic liaison between Systems/HW Design and Operations “Enforcing” high standard and quality for manufacturing readiness and knowing precisely when to push back on design elements that challenge manufacturability
 
•Change Control & Audits : Represent Operations by attending and activity presenting Manufacturability requirements at the Engineering Leadership CARBs (Change/Configuration Action review Boards)
 
•Compliance & Technical Reviews: Demonstrate, Organize and Execute Systems/HW programs reviews including CCB (Change Control Boards) and PRB (Program Review Boards) to mitigate electrical compliance
 
•Left Shift & Process Optimization: Drive early-Stage engagement through the P2L/NPI processes to shape, refine and mature hardware layouts prior to factory entry
 
•**Test Engineering Strategy and Operations Engagement**
 
•Production test architecture: Oversee and understand the vision and long-term production test strategy, ensuring test development frameworks are fully integrated with operations,
 
•Design-for-Test (DFT): Partner directly with Hardware Design and test development engineering to enforce strict Production Test requirements and enforcing the Operations Test Rules 
 
 
 
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills** 

•**Required Qualifications and Experience:**

•Education: Bachelors or Masters Degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Operations or a closely related technical discipline

•Experience Level: Minimum of 20+ years of dedicated System/HW designs and Engineering/Operational Leadership with complex digital and high-frequency RF hardware domain

•Domain Expertise: Technical proficiency of electronic warfare (EW) systems. Including an expert-level understanding of how the hardware behaves internally and externally under operating conditions. Understanding critical System Tradeoffs in electrical performance.

•LCM Mastery: Documented success reshaping the Life-Cycle Management (LCM) paradigms, establishing “Left-Shift” framework and streamlining product handoffs to manufacturing

•Governance: Extensive background running rigorous technical reviews, electrical compliance boards, CCBs and PRBs

 
 
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills** 

•**Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement**

•Cross Discipline Mobilization: Lead, Mentor and rally multi-discipline, cross-functional engineering and operational teams to achieve swift pragmatic solutions (Driving to high confidence \*80% rule)

Trend Analysis & Optimizations: Partner with the program engineering groups to monitor production trends, identify anomalies, isolate hardware failure modes, and making data driven discissions )
 
 
**Pay Information**
 
Full-Time Salary Range: $173023 - $294137
 
 
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
 
 
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. 
 
 
 
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
 
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
 
 
Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
 
 
This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Project Management - External Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
Rezolute is a pre-commercial ultra-rare disease company focused on significantly improving outcomes for individuals with hypoglycemia caused by hyperinsulinism (HI). Our fully human monoclonal antibody therapy, RZ358 (ersodetug), is designed to treat all forms of HI and has shown substantial benefit in clinical trials and real-world use for the treatment of congenital hyperinsulinism (cHI) and tumor hyperinsulinism (tHI).

**Position Summary**

Rezolute is seeking a proactive, execution-focused project management professional to coordinate external manufacturing programs as the company advances toward commercial manufacturing.

The Senior Manager, Project Management - External Manufacturing will manage integrated plans, communications, and deliverables across technology transfer, GMP manufacturing, process characterization, process validation, and commercial readiness. Working with internal functional leads and contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs), this individual will align schedules, supplier commitments, and cross-functional dependencies with Rezolute’s Plan of Record (POR), supply requirements, and business priorities.

This role owns project coordination and follow-through, not technical oversight. External Manufacturing Operations, Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT), Quality Assurance (QA), and designated functional experts retain responsibility for technical strategy, scientific assessments, manufacturing process decisions, and quality approvals.

### **Principal Duties and Responsibilities**

Integrated Project Planning and Execution

* Develop and maintain integrated project plans for external Drug Substance (DS) and Drug Product (DP) programs, defining scope, deliverables, owners, milestones, dependencies, and target dates.

* Align project baselines and supplier commitments with the POR, supply requirements, and approved priorities.

* Monitor critical-path activities and progress against plan; coordinate recovery actions for overdue or at-risk commitments with functional owners and suppliers.

* Assess scope, schedule, and resource changes with accountable stakeholders and route proposed changes through established approval processes.

Communications and Cross-Functional Coordination

* Serve as the project management point of contact between Rezolute teams and CDMOs, facilitating cross-functional coordination and timely communication of changes.

* Lead internal and supplier project meetings, using focused agendas to address progress, upcoming deliverables, dependencies, and decisions required.

* Maintain and distribute meeting records and action items with clear owners and due dates; drive follow-through to closure.

Workstream and Milestone Coordination

* Coordinate manufacturing and milestone readiness by tracking prerequisites, including material availability, documentation, internal reviews, and supplier deliverables.

* Integrate technical and quality review timelines into project schedules, including protocols, reports, and master or electronic batch records.

* Track schedule dependencies associated with change controls, deviations, investigations, and other quality-system activities in partnership with QA and technical owners.

* Coordinate handoffs from development and validation activities to routine commercial manufacturing, tracking agreed deliverables, receiving owners, and outstanding actions.

Risk, Issue, and Decision Management

* Maintain risk, issue, assumption, decision, and dependency logs, including accountable owners and required completion dates.

* Work with functional leads and suppliers to assess execution risks and track mitigation actions and residual risks.

* Facilitate issue resolution and escalate unresolved items or pending decisions, clearly communicating timing requirements and potential project impacts.

Reporting, Scope, and Project Controls

* Provide dashboards and leadership updates showing milestone performance, forecast completion dates, critical-path activities, risks, and decisions or intervention required.

* Partner with External Manufacturing leadership, Supplier Relationship Management (SRM), Business, and Procurement to define milestones, deliverables, assumptions, and timelines in supplier scopes of work.

* Support project-level financial tracking with budget owners, including planned work, supplier milestones, and the budget and schedule impacts of scope changes.

* Improve project management tools, reporting practices, and lessons-learned processes across the external manufacturing network.

### **Qualifications/Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, engineering, business, project management, or related discipline.

* Minimum of seven years of relevant biopharmaceutical industry experience, including responsibility for managing cross-functional projects involving CDMOs or other external manufacturing partners.

* Demonstrated ability to manage integrated schedules, critical-path activities, risks, and changing priorities across multiple workstreams.

* Experience coordinating technology transfer, GMP manufacturing, process characterization, process validation, or commercial manufacturing readiness activities.

* Working knowledge of biopharmaceutical manufacturing and cGMP requirements sufficient to understand project dependencies and engage effectively with technical and quality teams.

* Strong meeting facilitation, written communication, and stakeholder management skills, including communication with external partners and senior leadership.

* Ability to translate technical discussions into clear project actions, decisions, and schedule implications while respecting functional decision-making authority.

* Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through, with the ability to drive accountability and prioritize independently in a matrixed environment.

* Proficiency in Smartsheet or comparable project management software and Microsoft Teams, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience supporting late-stage biologics programs transitioning to commercial manufacturing.

* Experience coordinating DS and/or DP manufacturing projects across multiple external partners.

* Experience working in a small to mid-sized biotechnology company.

* Experience tracking project budgets, supplier scopes of work, and change requests.

Core Competencies:

* Project Planning and Controls: Creates practical plans that connect workstreams and support timely delivery.

* Execution and Accountability: Establishes ownership and follows through on commitments.

* Communication and Collaboration: Builds productive relationships and keeps internal and external teams aligned.

* Risk and Issue Management: Anticipates challenges, coordinates mitigation, and escalates appropriately.

* Adaptability and Prioritization: Adjusts plans as circumstances change while maintaining focus on program objectives.

Rezolute (RZLT) currently anticipates the base salary for Senior Manager - Project Management External Manufacturing role could range from $165,000 to $180,000 and will depend, in part, on the successful candidate’s geographical location and their qualifications for the role, including education and experience. This position will also be eligible for an annual performance bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan (depending, in part, on company and individual performance and at the Company’s discretion on an individual basis). The compensation described above is subject to change and could be higher or lower than the range described based on current market survey data and the qualifications, education, experience and geographical location of the selected candidate.

Qualifying employees are eligible to participate in benefit programs such as:

* Health Insurance (Medical / Dental / Vision)

* Disability, Life & Long-Term Care Insurance

* Holiday Pay

* Tracking Free Vacation Program

* 401(k) Plan Match

* Educational Assistance Benefit

* Fitness Center Reimbursement

new_roles.title: Quality Engineering Sr Manager - L6
new_roles.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

Manages those who apply quality principles in the areas of: design, incoming material, production control, product evaluation, program performance, reliability, inventory control, and/or research and development as they apply to product or process quality for make and/or buy products. Performs technical evaluations including product requirements, specifications, models/designs, drawings and procedures. Collaborates with program management, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and customers on quality related issues to ensure quality standards are in place. Engages in product failure investigations, material review board decisions and corrective/preventive action. Ensures corrective measures meet acceptable reliability standards and/or are compliant with requirements. Develops strategies and systems designed to improve internal and/or supplier performance and productivity. Evaluates quality systems for deficiency identification and correction. Designs and analyzes inspection and testing processes, mechanisms and equipment; conducts product quality tests, performs statistical analysis to assess products or materials that do not meet required standards and specifications. Engages in supplier selection process and maintain certification programs.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college
* 10 years of leadership experience
* 8 years flightline/flight test operations experience
* Quality experience - either in a quality organization or with significant exposure to quality processes
* Ability to travel

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Prior leadership experience in a unionized workforce environment
* AS9100/9110 experience
* Ability to interpret military service guidance
* Understanding of DCMAI 8210.1 (all revisions)
* Demonstrated ability to work in a blended environment with contractor & gov’t personnel - both military and civilian
* Experience developing BOE through negotiation and contract award
* Interpersonal skills required to develop effective working relationships
* Excellent presentation skills/ability to effectively communicate at all levels of the organization

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $178500.00 - $331500.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

**Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

* Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
* For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

new_roles.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy

**Job Description:**

**Sr. Manager, External Manufacturing Operations**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

As a **Sr, Manager of External Manufacturing Operations**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

* Owning the operational performance and strategic relationship of the external manufacturing partners supporting Brookings.
* Maintaining direct accountability for the continuity and availability of externally supplied materials and products required for Brookings manufacturing.
* Ensuring materials are available when needed, meet established specifications, and do not disrupt the manufacturing process.
* Establishing clear expectations for Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) performance across quality, delivery, capacity, cost, responsiveness, compliance, and supply continuity.
* Maintaining visibility to supplier production plans, materials, inventory, logistics, capacity, and constraints.
* Leading rapid response and escalation when supplier quality, capacity, production, logistics, technical, or operational issues threaten Brookings manufacturing.
* Driving containment, recovery, root cause, corrective action, and prevention to ensure issues are sustainably resolved.
* Establishing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the CMO network.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor's degree or higher in (completed and verified prior to start) AND twelve (12) years of combined experience in manufacturing, operations, external manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, planning, and/or procurement

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

 

* Experience managing contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), contract manufacturers, and/or strategic manufacturing suppliers
* Experience supporting medical device manufacturing within a regulated manufacturing environment
* Experience managing supply continuity, CMO capacity, production planning, supplier quality, asset strategy, and/or operational risk

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Experience applying medical device quality systems and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Experience applying GMP, supplier quality, change control, specifications, CAPA, SCARs, Quality Agreements, and/or regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience developing and executing CMO risk mitigation and business continuity strategies.
* Experience establishing supplier KPI dashboards, scorecards, and executive performance reviews.
* Experience supporting CMO contracts, Quality Agreements, commercial negotiations, and supplier performance management.
* Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, capital expenditure (CapEx) planning, and business case development.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving Manufacturing, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Value Stream Management, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, and/or external partners.
* Experience communicating, negotiating, and presenting recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders.

**Work location:**

* **Hybrid Eligible (Job Duties allow for some remote work but require travel to Brookings and other sites, including suppliers and other Solventum locations)** 
 **OR**
* **Remote in United States**

**Travel: May include up to 70% domestic/international**

**Relocation Assistance: May be authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

Applicable to US Applicants Only:The expected compensation range for this position is $187,600 - $257,950, which includes base pay plus variable incentive pay, if eligible. new_roles.title: Senior Manager, US Quality Operations
new_roles.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.

With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

As production grows, we need clear evidence that each spacecraft meets its requirements and a quality system that helps teams find and resolve risks early.

We are looking for a **Senior Manager, Quality Operations** to lead US quality for satellite buses and payloads from incoming material through building, test and acceptance. You will build a pragmatic system and lead engineers and inspectors close to the floor. You have independent authority to hold work or withhold readiness concurrence and to escalate unresolved mission risk. This is a hands-on leadership role in a fast-moving, dynamic environment.

**What you will do:**
=====================

* Lead US quality engineers and inspectors across supplier, receiving, production and test coverage. Set training, inspection points and delegated authority.
* Own fit-for-stage quality controls for document and configuration records, serial and lot traceability, calibration, nonconformances, corrective action and acceptance packages.
* Define risk-based controls for critical characteristics and supplier parts. Work with Supply Chain on qualifications, escapes, containment and verified corrective action.
* Make quality status visible through yield, repeat defects, escapes, NCR aging and acceptance-record completeness. Use trends to improve controls with Manufacturing and Engineering.
* Own the quality hold and escalation process. Engineering owns technical disposition; Quality evaluates controls and evidence and concurs on release.
* Concur independently on quality evidence at acceptance and flight readiness reviews. Escalate residual risk despite schedule pressure; partner with Engineering on reliability and mission risk.
* Align common requirements with the Canada Quality Lead and feed ground defects and on-orbit anomalies into later builds.

**What we are looking for**
===========================

* 8+ years in quality engineering or quality management for aerospace, defense or similarly complex hardware, including 3+ years directly leading engineers, inspectors or specialists through production and test.
* Experience building a usable QMS and leading teams through supplier escapes, nonconformances, root cause and corrective action.
* Independent judgment, strong technical communication and the ability to separate Engineering disposition from Quality release concurrence.
* Working knowledge of configuration control, risk-based inspection, process capability and cross-functional investigations.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, materials science, physics or a related technical field, or equivalent quality leadership experience in complex hardware.

**For U.S. Roles:** To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

**For U.K. Roles:** To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).

**For Canada Roles:** Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR.

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Manufacturing Engineering - Workplace Integration (General Assembly)
new_roles.description:
As a leader of a multi-disciplinary team of manufacturing engineers, you will be instrumental in launching new products and capacities at Rivian, transforming innovative ideas into tangible realities. This role sits at the intersection of product design, validation, factory design, and launch, ultimately delivering Rivian's best ideas into the hands of our customers. You will be responsible for leading and developing a motivated team of manufacturing SMEs in supporting all Rivian vehicle products and factories. This position is located at our Plymouth, MI headquarters or Georgia facility and will require significant travel to our manufacturing facilities in Normal, IL, and future locations. This role reports directly to the Director of Manufacturing Engineering in General Assembly.

 

* Lead a team of manufacturing engineers responsible for designing and executing workstation design aligned with lean manufacturing principles. Workstation design supports overall plant metrics of 90 - 95% utilization and greater than 50 value added elements. Start to finish ownership of workstation design from virtual build through launch.
* Support Rivian manufacturing lines and sites and cover factory layout, manufacturing technology selection, equipment design, process design, etc.
* A special focus of this team will be advancing Rivian’s manufacturing technology and innovation roadmap
* Conduct virtual builds, support design validation builds of next generation products and provide Design for Manufacturing and Assembly feedback, collaborating with vehicle architecture, design, software, and other upstream partners
* Define and execute launch and ramp strategies, collaborating with launch, operations, RPS, quality and design responsible teams
* Deliver production documentation such as JES, PFMEA, Control Plans etc.
* Develop and implement processes, standards and workflows to improve team efficiency
* Actively mentor and grow manufacturing engineers and managers through technical leadership, translate vision into action, inspiring from ideation to execution
* Actively engage in value engineering, challenge assumptions and break the status quo

 

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or similar technical field.
* 10+ years of experience in an engineering role related to manufacturing engineering, DFMA, product optimization, manufacturing process or equipment development
* Expertise in manufacturing and industrial engineering principles (OEE, cycle time analysis, DVA, Cp/Cpk, GR&R, ergonomics, DOE, quality control, equipment selection, ROI, error proofing, supply chain & logistics)
* Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems using first principles, challenge assumptions and biased towards action
* Proven technical leader that can lead and influence cross-functional teams launching new products, lean manufacturing workstations and material flow processes
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, ability to concisely summarize and escalate complex topics
* Experienced working within 2D & 3D CAD environments, simulation tools and other digital tools in the field of engineering

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance - Nights
new_roles.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
 
 
Position Description
 
Sr. Manager Quality Assurance (QA) Parenteral is responsible for the staffing, training, and leadership of the quality assurance group supporting the project/expansion delivery, process development, operational readiness, start up, and validation/qualification of the parenteral process including dispensing, equipment preparation, formulation, filling and visual inspection. The Sr. Manager will help build a strong quality culture and lead the QA team for oversight and support of the ongoing operation as well as site inspection readiness and execution.
 
 
**On-site Shift Schedule:** Monday to Friday 0800-1630 until qualified and then will transition to 1800-0600 (2, 2, 3 schedule).
 
**Direct Reports:** Night shift team 6pm to 6am
 
 
Key Objectives / Deliverables
 

* The Night Shift Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance, will support the start-up and routine operation of the QA organization overseeing Parenteral operations at Lilly's Kenosha, Wisconsin pharmaceutical manufacturing site. Responsibilities include technical and administrative leadership, as well as project management.
* Serve as technical resource to review and approve technical documents
* Network with cross-functional technical project delivery team to ensure equipment and systems comply with quality requirements and are implemented with a Quality by Design framework
* Work with the Associate Director, Quality Assurance to support the development of the vision, strategy and quality culture for the overall site quality assurance organization with focus on the formulation, filling and visual inspection programs
* Support initial recruiting, build capability, for a diverse leadership and quality assurance staff to support qualification, validation and routine production
* Manage a team of up to approximately 8-12 direct reports
* Support the site to ensure a safe work environment including supporting and leading safety efforts for your team
* Support the development of the overall site operational readiness plan including development of quality processes and approval of operational procedures and controls
* Foster a strong quality culture including maintaining open communications and promoting teamwork and employee participation in the work group
* Supervise, coach, and aid in employee development and performance management; ensure a fair and equitable work environment
* Review and approve GMP documentation including procedures, deviations, technical reports, change controls, etc.
* Network with global and other parenteral sites to understand best practices and share knowledge
* Work cross-functionally with the area process teams for metrics reviews, operational support, and issue/deviation management
* Support inspection readiness activities
* Interact with regulatory agencies during inspections regarding cGMP issues
* Ensure data integrity by design

**Requirements:** 

* Bachelor's degree in a science, engineering, or related field of study
* 5+ years in pharmaceutical leadership including leading or working effectively with a cross-functional group
* Excellent interpersonal, written and oral communication skills
* Strong technical aptitude and ability to train and mentor others
* Ability to work overtime as required
* Ability to travel 10-25% to other Lilly sites for training/meetings
* May be required to respond to operational issues outside of core business hours and days

**Preferred attributes but not required:** 

* Commit to successfully maintain Lilly Computer System Quality Assurance (CSQA) Certification
* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems and applicable regulatory requirements
* Previous experience directly supporting a pharmaceutical manufacturing operation
* Excellent interpersonal, written and oral communication skills
* Strong technical aptitude and ability to train and mentor others
* Demonstrated technical writing skills
* Demonstrated problem-solving and decision-making skills
* Previous facility or area start up experience
* Previous equipment qualification and process validation experience
* Previous experience with highly automated syringe filling, vial filling, and visual inspection equipment
* Previous experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems and electronic batch release
* CQM, CQE, or CQA certification from the American Society for Quality (ASQ)
* Previous experience with deviation and change management systems including Trackwise, MasterConrrol, and Veeva

**Additional Information:** 
This job specification is intended to provide a general overview of the job requirements at the time it was prepared. The job requirements of any position may change over time and may include additional responsibilities not specifically described in the job specification. As always, you should consult with your supervisor regarding your actual job responsibilities and any related duties that may be required for the position.
 
Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.
 
 
Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.
 
 
Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL).
 
 
Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is
 
$97,500 - $143,000
 
 
Full-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees.

new_roles.description:
**Job Description**

**General Summary**
-------------------

The Manufacturing Technical Services Senior Manager provides technical leadership for commercial manufacturing operations for Spray Dried Dispersion (SDD) at external manufacturing partners. The role is accountable for overseeing technical services activities across the commercial manufacturing lifecycle, including manufacturing readiness, process performance, technical investigations, change management, process improvement, and supply-risk mitigation.

The Senior Manager partners with Manufacturing Operations, MS&T, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, and CDMOs/CMOs to ensure manufacturing processes are robust, compliant, reliable, and capable of supporting product supply. The role leads complex cross-functional technical workstreams and develops technical talent within the Manufacturing Technical Services organization.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Lead Manufacturing Technical Services support for assigned commercial manufacturing programs and external manufacturing partners.
* Establish technical plans and priorities to support manufacturing readiness, commercial production campaigns, product supply, and lifecycle-management objectives.
* Provide technical oversight during manufacturing execution; lead escalation and resolution of complex process, equipment, yield, and manufacturing-performance issues.
* Lead technical investigations of significant manufacturing deviations, process excursions, yield loss, equipment failures, and product-quality events; ensure root cause, technical impact, and sustainable corrective actions are clearly defined.
* Oversee manufacturing, process, analytical, and batch-performance trending to identify emerging risks, assess process robustness, and prioritize improvement opportunities.
* Lead technical assessment and approval of change controls, risk assessments, comparability assessments, process updates, and related manufacturing documentation.
* Partner with Manufacturing Operations and Supply Chain to assess technical constraints, manage manufacturing and supply risks, and develop recovery or mitigation plans.
* Lead technical governance with CDMOs/CMOs, including performance review, issue escalation, technical decision-making, data review, and follow-up of technical deliverables.
* Collaborate with MS&T, Quality, Engineering, and Regulatory Affairs to ensure technical strategies align with process-validation requirements, cGMP expectations, regulatory commitments, and product lifecycle plans.
* Lead continuous-improvement initiatives that enhance process robustness, product quality, yield, manufacturing efficiency, and supply reliability.
* Develop, mentor, and provide technical directions to Manufacturing Technical Services staff and matrixed technical teams.
* Travel to support on-site manufacturing activities, CDMO/CMO operations, audits, inspections, and business needs as required (10-20% travel expected)

**Knowledge and Skills**
------------------------

* Deep understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, testing, controls, and commercial manufacturing operations for Spray Dried Dispersion (SDD)
* Strong knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices, pharmaceutical quality systems, and controlled-documentation requirements.
* Demonstrated experience with commercial manufacturing support, technical services, process monitoring, product lifecycle management, and external manufacturing oversight.
* Advanced experience leading complex technical investigations, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, change controls, risk assessments, and process-improvement initiatives.
* Ability to interpret manufacturing, process, and analytical data; identify process-performance trends; assess technical risks; and recommend practical, sustainable solutions.
* Understanding of manufacturing operations, maintenance, engineering, equipment performance, capacity constraints, and supply-continuity planning.
* Experience leading CDMO/CMO technical relationships, including governance, performance management, technical issue resolution, and escalation.
* Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence decisions without direct authority.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, strategic-thinking, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and relevant manufacturing or business systems.

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Biological Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Materials Science, or a related scientific or technical discipline.
* Typically requires 8+ years of experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, chemical, or another regulated manufacturing environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Significant experience supporting commercial manufacturing operations, technical services, MS&T, process development, engineering, quality, or external manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical programs, manufacturing workstreams, complex investigations, process improvements, or cross-functional teams.
* Experience working in a cGMP environment and supporting controlled manufacturing documentation is required.
Demonstrate people leadership, matrix leadership, or technical leadership experience is required.

We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

**Pay Range:**

$138,700 - $208,100

**Disclosure Statement:**

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

Hybrid-Eligible Or On-Site Eligible

**Flex Eligibility Status:**

In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:
 
1. **Hybrid** : work remotely up to two days per week; **or select** 
2. **On-Site** : work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.
