new_roles.title: Director, Inventory Management & Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Be visionary**

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

**Job Description**

The Director, Inventory Management & Operational Excellence will lead a new enterprise team that brings inventory back to plan and keeps it there. The role installs a standard inventory management system at Teledyne sites: control of the material coming in, sound stocking policy and planning, and regular reviews that turn data into decisions. The Director leads the program and works hands-on at one site at a time, starting in our defense businesses.

A key part of this role involves partnering with Segment leadership, site General Managers, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to set standard work, build site capability, and deliver sustainable business results, supporting enterprise objectives for working capital, on-time delivery, and margin.

**This role requires up to 75% travel. Due to the extensive travel involved, candidates may be based anywhere within the United States.**

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead standard site assessments of planning maturity, part-level inventory, and forecast accuracy, and partner with site leadership to prioritize and execute improvement opportunities.
* Set and deploy baseline standard work for every site, including weekly action on MRP messages for open purchase orders, receiving to plan, monthly inventory forecast reporting, and documented decisions on excess, obsolete, and aged WIP inventory.
* Drive inventory optimization and working capital improvement initiatives across the organization. Lead tactical controls on open purchase orders and receipts first, then structural fixes to safety stock, min/max settings, inventory entitlement, and planning.
* Own the guiding metric: material and labor going into inventory vs. cost of goods shipped, tracked monthly and forecast a year ahead, so sites act before inventory builds.
* Establish and implement enterprise inventory policies, standards, and governance, including decision rights for buying ahead of demand, keeping excess, and disposing of obsolete material.
* Run the monthly enterprise inventory review with senior leadership, using KPI dashboards to monitor every site, identify gaps, and drive accountability.
* Co-lead each site’s weekly material exception review and monthly General Manager inventory review, then coach site leaders to run them on their own.
* Strengthen SIOP, demand forecasting, and make-to-stock or make-to-order decisions with site planning teams, from opportunity identification through implementation and sustainment.
* Leverage AI-enabled technologies, automation, and advanced analytics to improve inventory decisions, reporting, and business performance.
* Capture what works at each site in a standard playbook and share best practices across the enterprise.
* Lead and develop a team of one Manager and two Inventory Analysts working two sites at a time.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* MBA preferred.
* 10+ years of leadership experience in Operations, Supply Chain, Materials Management, or Operational Excellence, including site-level operations or supply chain leadership.
* APICS CPIM or CSCP, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, preferred.
* Experience supporting multi-site manufacturing and global business environments.
* Ability to travel up to 75%, including extended on-site periods during site engagements, to work with site teams, run operational reviews, and develop site leaders across Teledyne business units.

**Qualifications and Competencies**

* Proven ability to lead cross-functional improvement initiatives and deliver measurable inventory and working capital results.
* Deep knowledge of materials management and supply chain planning, including MRP, open purchase order management, safety stock and inventory policy, SIOP, and demand forecasting.
* Working knowledge of Lean, Standard Work, and Root Cause Problem Solving.
* Experience deploying and sustaining business systems or enterprise operating models across multiple sites or business units, with hands-on factory and supply chain experience.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Passion for continuous improvement, emerging technologies, AI-enabled business transformation, and operational excellence.

* Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills, including leading site teams without direct authority.
* Experience utilizing KPI dashboards, operational scorecards, and performance management systems.
* Experience working in ERP systems (SAP preferred) and across multiple ERP environments.

**Due to the type of work performed and facility access requirements, applicants must be a "U.S. Person" (U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, asylee, or refugee).**

**Salary Range:**

$170,900.00-$227,900.000

The anticipated salary range listed for this role is only an estimate. Actual compensation for successful candidates is carefully determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, location, local regulations (such as minimum wage), education/training, work experience, key skills, and type of position.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations (Boston, MA)
new_roles.description:
About Mendocino Farms
 
At Mendocino Farms, we do a lot more than just sell sandwiches and salads. We are a fast-casual restaurant brand on a mission to bring people together through fresh, culinary-driven food and unmatched hospitality. As we continue our aggressive growth trajectory across new and existing markets, we are seeking a dynamic, analytical, and hands-on leader to elevate our total rewards structure.
 
Our Core Values and Mantras
 

* Sell Happy: The foundational philosophy that goes beyond serving meals to actively uplifting and improving every guest's day.
* Food Should Make People Feel Good: A commitment to using high-quality, whole, and thoughtfully sourced ingredients that make eating well easy.
* Be Culinary Explorers: A passion for combining fresh ingredients and bold flavors in unexpected, gourmet ways.
* Turn the Ordinary into the Extraordinary: Treating every customer and team interaction as a chance to lift someone's spirits.
* Get Better Every Day (GBED): An internal mantra encouraging continuous learning, personal growth, and skill development.

We are Mendocino Farms, a unique, fast-casual restaurant concept breaking all the old paradigms of the restaurant business. At Mendocino Farms, we exist to sell more than just sandwiches, we sell happy. We are where the neighborhood comes together over inspired sandwiches and soulful salads made from thoughtfully sourced ingredients. Our name comes from legendary Mendocino County, a town known for pioneering the slow food movement and sustainable farming. At Mendo, we make daily decisions that reinforce our values of being trailblazers, learning and growing, building a ‘we’ culture, winning the day for our guests and our team members to ultimately, selling happy!
 
SUMMARY
 
As a DIRECTOR OF OPERATIONS for Mendocino Farms you will lead a team of restaurant operators focused on operational excellence. You will be responsible for leading, managing and developing our operators throughout the Boston Area. You’ll be an active member of the Operations Leadership Team and help to shape operations strategy as well as ensure that the company’s strategic initiatives come to light in your market.
 
The right candidate is a proven leader and operator, familiar with high growth environments, skilled at managing a P&L, is an excellent communicator, sets a high bar for him/herself, and is adept at developing talent. If you are someone who thrives in a critical leadership position and gains personal satisfaction when sharing knowledge and driving operational excellence, then this is a great role for you.
 
This role will be based in the Greater Boston area and will require travel for training, and periodic travel to Los Angeles.
 
RESPONSIBILITIES
 

* Manage field operations teams to deliver on our mission of Selling Happy
* Monitor and drive flawless execution in day-to-day operations; visit our restaurants often to ensure that all aspects of the business meet established guidelines and standards across all dayparts and parts of the week.
* Hire, train, develop, retain and evaluate leadership talent to create and maintain high performing teams that reduce turnover, create succession & growth and ensure that our top talent is ready to take on additional responsibilities.
* Assist with the development of strategic and tactical plans for the market and ensure the completion of each, holding individuals accountable to assigned tasks.
* Monitor all aspects of the business in-person and by using the various methods and reporting tools available (Daily sales reports, score cards, guest insights, labor and food cost tools), and then use the data and personal observations to coach and re-established goals.
* Develop and execute plans and initiatives that consistently achieve and beat the company's desired sales and profitability targets for both existing and newly established operations.
* Champion the operating culture by delivering a high level of system-wide operations execution that exceed guest expectations in each restaurant, every shift, every time; build a culture of accountability to financial and operational standards.
* Ensure flawless opening, execution and results of new restaurant openings by playing an active role during pre and post opening.
* Develop and maintain relationships across the company to ensure productive partnerships with various cross functional business partners and disciplines at Base Camp
* Deliver consistently on the company's goals and KPI’s
* Exhibit leadership by example through effective coaching, motivating and reinforcing the company's operating principles and core values while maintaining a high level of visibility with company operations.
* Demonstrate progress through analysis and forecasting and presentation of conclusions and recommendations to the executive team.
* Ensure compliance with all local laws and regulations as well as company policy as it relates to the running of your market especially as it relates to food safety and labor laws
* Maintain a strong industry network and local market knowledge for our brand.
* The role requires responding to critical and urgent, non-routine operational matters and emergencies outside of standard business hours. When on approved PTO, there is the option to delegate emergency coverage to a colleague.

**ESSENTIAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** 

* 7+ years of successful restaurant management/leadership operations experience required.
* Previous senior leadership experience leading large restaurant teams in a geographically dispersed operations environment
* Demonstrated ability to lead people and get results through others.
* Ability to organize and manage multiple priorities
* Familiar with Microsoft Office, and experience with using Excel.
* High performance teams and a strong team player
* Skill in assessing and prioritizing multiple tasks, projects, and demands
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

**Physical Requirements:** 

* Must be able to lift 50 pounds.
* Sitting / standing 8-14 hours.
* Hand use: single grasping, fine manipulation, pushing and pulling
* Work requires the following motions: bending, twisting, squatting, and reaching

There is no “I” in Mendo
 
Mendocino Farms is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. Mendocino Farms will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment in a manner consistent with the Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring requirements.
 

* This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the Team Member for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & FAIR CHANCE EMPLOYMENT STATEMENT
 
Mendocino Farms is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

new_roles.title: Executive Director, Research Administration Transformation & Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
Discover Your Career at Emory University: Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community. Description:

The Executive Director for Research Administration Transformation & Operational Excellence provides executive strategic and operational leadership for the Office of Research Administration's (ORA) enterprise-wide transformation portfolio.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Leads an enterprise-wide transformation portfolio spanning research administration functions across schools, units, and Emory Healthcare, requiring university-wide change leadership and executive influence.
* Partners with Artificial Intelligence & Digital Strategy (AI & DS) to implement a broad portfolio that includes enterprise technology implementation (including the Insight grants management system), organizational redesign, shared services transformation, operational performance improvement, artificial intelligence and emerging technology strategy, and research administration training and professional development.
* Directs implementation, ongoing maintenance, and optimization of enterprise systems and tools, including Insight and LegalSifter, and ensures that technology investments support the future-state operating model.
* Co-leads implementation and ongoing review of future-state operating model, including organizational design, workflow refinement, shared services transformation, and operational performance.
* Exercises decision-making authority over implementation, configuration alignment, workflow and business process design, user acceptance, vendor management, future-state operating model alignment, and continuous refinement across pre-award, post-award, agreements, effort reporting, personnel, and compliance modules.
* Manages vendor performance (including Huron), monitors project milestones, and reports status, risks, decisions, and outcomes to the Vice President and Steering Committee.
* Holds executive accountability for realization of transformation outcomes, including organizational effectiveness, service excellence, operational efficiency, adoption, and sustained performance improvement.
* Partners with AI & DS to implement technology programs and enabling capabilities required for responsible AI success. This includes project management, development and evaluation of workflows, tool evaluation, implementation, governance, workforce readiness, and adoption. Manages technology evaluation, implementation, and security coordination in partnership with Emory OIT and Information Security.
* Serves as ORA's operational technologies (Insight, SciShield, Huron, etc.) liaison to central technology and governance bodies.
* Provides subject matter expertise to the Learning and Organizational Development team for the design and deployment of a scalable, role-based training ecosystem that includes Insight and Compass system training, process-compliance content, change enablement, and professional development for ORA and school-based research administration staff.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, public administration, health administration, or a related field from an accredited institution and eight years of progressively responsible professional experience in related research administration experience, including a minimum of five years of experience in a management role with direct supervisory responsibility.
* Master's degree (MBA, MPA, MHA, MS, or related discipline) strongly preferred.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

* Master's degree or doctoral degree in a relevant field.
* Experience with Huron's Insight platform at an R1 university or academic medical center in a project leadership or system administration capacity.
* Direct, client-side experience supporting or co-leading a management consulting engagement (EY, Huron Consulting, Deloitte, or equivalent) in a research or academic operations context.
* Experience building or leading a training, learning and development, or organizational capability function in a higher education or healthcare research environment.
* Knowledge of AI governance frameworks, responsible AI principles, and federal data security and research security requirements.
* Demonstrated experience with process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or equivalent); certification preferred.
* Professional certification in one or more of the following: research administration (CRA or CPRA), project management (PMP), or change management (Prosci ADKAR / CCMP).
* Experience in a centralized or shared services research administration environment, particularly at an institution transitioning from a decentralized model.
* Familiarity with Emory University's systems, culture, and governance structure, or comparable experience at an AAU or Carnegie R1 institution.

NOTE: Position tasks are generally required to be performed in-person at an Emory University location. Remote work from home day options may be granted at department discretion. Emory reserves the right to change remote work status with notice to employee.

#LI-MR1

Additional Details: Emory is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by state or federal law. Emory University does not discriminate in admissions, educational programs, or employment, including recruitment, hiring, promotions, transfers, discipline, terminations, wage and salary administration, benefits, and training. Students, faculty, and staff are assured of participation in university programs and in the use of facilities without such discrimination. Emory University complies with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Era Veteran's Readjustment Assistance Act, and applicable executive orders, federal and state regulations regarding nondiscrimination, equal opportunity, and affirmative action (for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities). Inquiries regarding this policy should be directed to the Emory University Department of Equity and Civil Rights Compliance, 201 Dowman Drive, Administration Building, Atlanta, GA 30322. Telephone: 404-727-9867 (V) | 404-712-2049 (TDD).
 
 
Emory University is committed to ensuring equal access and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities upon request. To request this document in an alternate format or to seek a reasonable accommodation, please contact the Department of Accessibility Services at accessibility@emory.edu or call 404-727-9877 (Voice) | 404-712-2049 (TDD). We kindly ask that requests be made at least seven business days in advance to allow adequate time for coordination.

new_roles.description:
1.0 FTE Full time Day - 08 Hour R2655441 Hybrid 108400006 SC Administration Business & Administration PALO ALTO, 1840 Embarcadero, California

If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

 
Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

**This is a Stanford Health Care job.** 
 
**A Brief Overview** 
The Director of Supply Chain Operational Excellence is a senior leadership role driving enterprise‑wide efficiency, innovation, and transformation across a Gartner top‑2 ranked healthcare supply chain. With system‑wide influence and a seat at the leadership table, this role partners closely with the Chief Supply Chain Officer and Vice President of Strategic Initiatives to turn strategy into measurable results. The ideal candidate combines healthcare supply chain expertise with strong program management skills and a passion for developing people, leading change, and delivering measurable, enterprise‑wide impact. 
 
**Locations** 
Stanford Health Care 
 
**What you will do**

* Maintain continuous alignment with defined organizational and departmental strategic business objectives in conjunction with leadership.
* Direct and ensure the efficient operation of day-to-day activities of the team and ensure competency of all staff.
* Supports and partners on Change Management, Training and Communications activities as needed for effective performance improvement and project management.
* Act in an advisory capacity to all Supply Chain divisions, programs, staff and leaders.
* Provide expertise, guidance and training on Performance Improvement and Project Management best practices.
* Apply LEAN/Six Sigma principles and methods to identify waste reduction and performance optimization opportunities across Supply Chain operations.
* Implement, oversee and continuously improve Supply Chain systems, processes and standard work to drive the efficient management of operations across Logistics, Sourcing, Procurement, Business Office, Resiliency, Sustainability, Data Management and other functions.
* Build, develop and grow business relationships with Supply Chain’s key stakeholders and partners including but not limited to the Interventional Platform, A/P, Pharmacy, and IT.
* Lead cross-departmental initiatives, establishing strong governance, communication, and accountability to deliver progress measurable through mutually agreed KPIs.
* Align and collaborate with the enterprise Performance Improvement team and Stanford Operating System (SOS).
* Lead the implementation of programs and/or projects as assigned by the Administrative Director.

**Education Qualifications**

* Requires a Bachelor’s degree in a work-related discipline/field from an accredited college or university.
* Relevant experience in lieu of degree may be considered. Relevant experience in lieu of degree is in addition to the experience requirements for this position.

**Experience Qualifications**

* Seven (7) years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience.

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Must have strong leadership and interpersonal skills and be effective at people management including the ability to delegate assignments and share decision-making with team members and direct reports as appropriate.
* Excellent communication skills including the ability to present, and to write in a clear and understandable manner.
* Ability to understand complex verbal or written instructions and translate to action to deliver quantitative and qualitative results.
* Must be well organized and systematic, and able to design, implement and maintain standard work processes.
* Knowledge of project management methodologies to lead complex project teams and large scope projects, including managing resources (people, costs, time).
* Familiar with and able to apply Lean Six Sigma concepts and techniques including value stream mapping, kaizen, Five Whys, VoC, RCA etc. for structured process improvement.
* Demonstrated expertise in leading change management initiatives within Agile delivery environments.
* Ability to multi-task and handle multiple priorities while managing aggressive deadlines. Knowledge of Supply Chain functions, practices, and operational challenges.
* Understanding of healthcare and clinical concepts.

**Licenses and Certifications**

* Lean Six Sigma Certification preferred .
* PMP - Project Mgmt Professional preferred .
* CMRP (Certified Materials & Resource Professionals) preferred.

**Physical Demands and Work Conditions** 
**Blood Borne Pathogens**

* Category II - Tasks that involve NO exposure to blood, body fluids or tissues, but employment may require performing unplanned Category I tasks

**These principles apply to ALL employees:** 
 
**SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient & Family Experience** 
 
*Stanford Health Care sets a high standard for delivering value and an exceptional experience for our patients and families. Candidates for employment and existing employees must adopt and execute C-I-CARE standards for all of patients, families and towards each other. new_roles.title: Director, Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Saratoga Springs
* Req ID:R53235
* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We’re hiring an Associate Director/Director of Operational Excellence for our highly automated bulk/ drug substance manufacturing plant, supporting 20–30 tech transfers a year alongside commercial delivery responsibility. GMP production will run concurrently with construction and CQV for 3–5 years. This role requires both building and operating.

 
 

This site operates on a foundation of strategy, execution, and discipline. Every function at the site owns a pyramid of metrics derived from annual goal planning that connects the site’s strategic goals to the factory floor, with performance measured back up to leadership to monitor, track, and mitigate against contingencies quantified using SMART goals in days and dollars.

 
 

The Associate Director/Director of Operational Excellence runs our site MDI (managing for daily improvements) OpEx, continuous improvement programs, and all site PMO operations owning the site project register and deciding how work is staffed and prioritized across the project portfolio while coordinating cross-functional projects. They build the operating rhythm that turns discrete functions into one aligned site team as the site scales to six suites, and owns the site’s strategy, execution, and culture discipline planning. Lead executive-level investigations and special initiatives as project/program lead, absorbing crisis response so operational leaders can stay focused on daily management.

 
 

**When & where:**

* Location: Saratoga Springs, New York, United States

* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
 

 

**Discover your role:**

* Run site MDI including ownership of the Tier 6 site critical issue forum, ensuring cross-functional blockers are surfaced and resolved quickly

* Establish and sustain the site's cadence of daily, weekly, and monthly forums so issues are raised and resolved at the right level

* Lead OpEx and continuous improvement programs, building and prioritizing a CI project pipeline and delivering realized savings

* Lead all site PMO activities, owning the site project register and deciding how work is staffed and prioritized across the project portfolio, coordinating cross-functional projects and site initiatives and driving on-time delivery

* Own site strategy, execution, and rigor planning for culture translating strategic priorities into a disciplined, trackable execution plan across the site

* Own MDI and all standard work initiatives site-wide, ensuring consistent methodology and application across every function and suite

* Own site-wide implementation of lean principles building and driving the phased adoption roadmap across leadership, suites, and functions, from initial leadership alignment through daily floor-level practice

* Own site business analytics building and maintaining the reporting, dashboards, and KPI infrastructure that drive MDI, CI prioritization, and Site Leadership Team decision-making

* Co-lead the monthly finance/business review with finance operations, reconciling cost and capital needs against the site's financial plan

* Coach leaders and teams in Lean and problem-solving methods and build an OpEx culture across the site

* Embed MDI and OpEx practices as suites come online so new suites start up with the site's operating standards

* Partner with manufacturing, quality, technical services, technical operations, supply chain, and Finance as a member of the site leadership team

* Embed the digital and connected plant model in site MDI, using real-time data and digital tools for daily management and escalation

* Own the site's multi-year operational efficiency roadmap, driving leaner operations and delivering year-over-year efficiency gains

* Build, coach, and retain a high-performing OpEx team; establish high standards for performance management and accountability; perform other duties as required

* Own a gross margin improvement program and goal for this function, contributing to the site's overall margin performance

* Ensure this function's metrics flow up and down through the MDI structure, connecting into the site's S&OP, AOP, and long-range planning cycles

* Own these function's OpEx and CapEx budget and roadmap

* Serve as the primary party responsible for this function's alignment with the Global Center of Excellence (COE), connecting site execution back to the business-level function
 

 

**This role requires:**

* B.S in engineering, life sciences, business or related technical field
* MBA & PMP certification preferred

* + Associate Director: 10+ years of operational excellence, continuous improvement, or manufacturing operations or biopharmaceuticals including 5+ years of progressive leadership

* + Director: 12+ years in operational excellence, continuous improvement, or manufacturing operations or biopharmaceuticals including 7+ years of progressive leadership

* + Level will be determined based on experience

* Previous people leadership/supervisory experience

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.

Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.

 
 

Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.

 
 

As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.

 
 

For jobs in Canada: this posting is for an existing position.

 
 

**Salary Range (annually)**

$150,800.00 - $292,700.00

new_roles.title: Sr. Director Operations
new_roles.description:
**What makes DHL great?** Our People! We know each employee’s individual contributions make us the #1 Express Delivery and Logistics Company in the world.

***Distinguished as No. 1 World’s Best Workplace™ by Great Place to Work and Fortune Magazine***

DHL Express is committed to maintaining an environment that empowers every team member to make the greatest possible impact on our business. Our culture is about personal commitment – to our business, to each other and to our global communities. DHL is dedicated to being a great place to work. In addition to competitive compensation packages, our employees enjoy a range of programs, services and benefits that bring the best to their personal lives.

**Start YOUR career with DHL today…**

The **Sr. Director Operations** is responsible for providing strategic input and leading the implementation of the Courier and Pick-up & Delivery strategy. This role ensures the safe, secure, timely, and accurate transportation and delivery of mail, parcels, small packages, and legal documents between locations, in alignment with business objectives, operational requirements, corporate guidelines, and policies.

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Provide input to develop Couriers, Pick-up & Delivery operations strategy to deliver effective collection, transportation, and delivery of parcels while maintaining exceptional service quality and customer satisfaction.
* Plan, organize and control preparation of annual business plans, operational budgets, workforce planning, and resource allocation for delivery operations.
* Provide expertise, coaching, and leadership to frontline managers and supervisors to ensure execution of daily operational activities, achievement of performance targets, and development of future leaders.
* Manage and control service point operations to enable efficient collection, handling, and distribution of shipments while maintaining compliance with operational standards.
* Manage and control scheduling of transportation capacity, traffic volumes, route structures, and delivery resources to maximize productivity and service performance.
* Lead a workforce of more than 1,000 employees across multiple facilities, fostering a culture of accountability, engagement, safety, and operational excellence.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge and experience operating in unionized environments, including labor relations, contract interpretation, grievance resolution, workforce planning, and effective collaboration with union leadership.
* Oversee large independent contractor (IC) networks and transportation providers, ensuring contractual compliance, operational performance, cost management, and service reliability.
* Drive operational expense (OPEX) management through disciplined financial oversight, productivity initiatives, route optimization, and continuous improvement programs to achieve profitability objectives.
* Partner closely with Network Operations, Gateway Operations, Brokerage, Customs, Aviation, and Commercial teams to ensure seamless execution of customer commitments and network requirements.
* Deploy structured approaches to manage operational procedures including shipment processing, sorting, loading/unloading, documentation, scanning compliance, manifests, secure handling, and custody control.
* Implement reporting standards, performance metrics, and operational dashboards to provide visibility into service performance, cost drivers, productivity, and customer experience measures.
* Anticipate changes in customer demand, economic conditions, labor markets, and transportation trends to proactively adjust operational strategies and resource requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation, delivery, and customer service solutions through process redesign, technology implementation, and network optimization.
* Monitor operational performance and implement continuous improvement initiatives focused on service quality, productivity, safety, employee engagement, and cost control.
* Lead multiple delivery bases and service centers across geographically diverse markets, ensuring consistent execution of operational standards and business objectives.
* Champion safety, security, and compliance programs while maintaining adherence to company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Build strong relationships with key customers, local business leaders, and internal stakeholders to support growth initiatives and enhance the overall customer experience.
* Drive organizational change initiatives, workforce transformation efforts, and strategic projects across the region while maintaining high levels of employee engagement and operational performance.

**Skills/Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 8+ years of experience in operations and leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience in budgetary management and financial accountability.
* Strong background in business and operations management, including managing complex operational environments.
* Experience leading courier, Pick-up & Delivery, dock, and transportation operations.
* Proven ability to lead change management and operational improvement initiatives.
* Strong strategic planning and execution capabilities.
* Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Proven leadership experience managing a department or business unit comprising multiple teams, including Managers and/or Team Leaders.
* Strong ability to lead, develop, and influence leaders and teams to achieve business and operational objectives.
* Experience establishing priorities, managing resources, and driving performance across multiple operational functions.
* Demonstrated ability to drive employee engagement, foster an inclusive and high-performing culture, and develop strategies that strengthen employee experience, retention, and organizational effectiveness.

**Employee Benefits & Incentives**

DHL Express benefits and incentive offerings are designed to reflect a substantial experience for both employees and their dependents during their career and life journey. The specifics will vary, but wherever you join and in whatever role, you'll find our benefits and rewards are among the best in the industry They include:

* Competitive Pay - Salary Range New Jersey $187,950- $250,600
* Bonus/Incentive Programs
* Retirement Savings – 401K with company match
* Medical, Dental, Vision, well-being programs
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Generous Paid Time Off – Starting at 4 Weeks (PT/FT)
* Paid Leave
* Employee Discount Program
* Employee Assistance & Work Life Program
* Outstanding training opportunities

*DHL is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status,* *or any other protected characteristic. The EEO is the Law poster is available here:* *https://www.eeoc.gov/employers/eeo-law-poster*

*We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to* *participate* *in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.* *Please contact us to request accommodation.*

new_roles.title: Director of Operational Excellence and Implementation (REMOTE)
new_roles.description:
**Job Summary:** 
 
The **Director of Operational Excellence and Implementation** provides strategic leadership and execution support for priority operational initiatives in partnership with the Chief Operating Officer and Operations leaders. This role translates organizational priorities into actionable implementation plans, leads assigned cross-functional initiatives, improves operational processes, and drives sustainable improvements in how work is performed.

The Director leads efforts to move initiatives from strategy through execution by developing implementation plans, establishing timelines and accountability, coordinating cross-functional activities, identifying risks and barriers, measuring progress, and providing clear visibility to leadership. The role also partners with teams to evaluate and redesign processes, strengthen procedures and documentation, improve cross-training and operational continuity, and identify opportunities to enhance efficiency through technology, automation, and self-service.

This role requires demonstrated experience leading operational improvement initiatives, managing complex projects, influencing across teams, and successfully implementing change. Success in this role requires strong strategic thinking, project execution, problem-solving, communication, and relationship-building skills, along with the ability to drive accountability and deliver measurable results.

This role follows a hybrid work arrangement, with the majority of time worked remotely and periodic in-office requirements in our downtown Chicago office.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Implementation and Project Coordination** **(40%)**

* **Develop and maintain implementation plans, timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and action items for priority Operations initiatives.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coordinate activities across teams and follow up on commitments, deliverables, and outstanding actions.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Track project progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and issues requiring leadership attention.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Prepare concise status updates and other progress reporting for the COO and appropriate leaders.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Lead assigned cross-functional Operations initiatives from planning through implementation, working with department leaders to establish accountability, resolve barriers, and deliver agreed upon outcomes.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Facilitate working sessions to clarify responsibilities, resolve implementation issues, and move work from discussion to action.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Partner with Operations leaders to advance agreed priorities, clarify responsibilities, and strengthen accountability while maintaining departmental ownership of ongoing operations.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Process Improvement (30%)**

* **Review and document selected operational processes and workflows.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Work with staff to identify unnecessary steps, manual work, duplication, unclear handoffs, and other opportunities for improvement.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Develop practical recommendations to simplify workflows, improve consistency, and strengthen operational effectiveness.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Lead assigned process improvement initiatives in partnership with department leaders, including implementation and evaluation of results.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help develop and maintain standard operating procedures and other operational documentation.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthen cross-training and backup coverage for critical processes.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identify appropriate opportunities to improve workflows through technology, automation, and self-service.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Operational Change and Coordination (20%)**

* **Lead or coordinate implementation of assigned process, technology, and organizational changes within Operations, in partnership with the responsible department leaders.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coordinate operational activities associated with selected technology implementations and other modernization initiatives.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help ensure changes are supported by appropriate documentation, communications, training, and follow-up.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Bring together the appropriate staff and leaders when work crosses departmental boundaries.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help clarify responsibilities and handoffs when ownership is unclear.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identify implementation barriers and work with the appropriate leaders to resolve or escalate them.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Monitor recently implemented changes and help address issues affecting adoption or effectiveness.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Measurement and Reporting (10%)**

* **Establish practical measures for selected initiatives and operational improvements.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Develop baseline information when needed to evaluate the impact of a change.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Monitor whether implemented changes are achieving expected results.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Use available operational data and staff or candidate feedback to identify areas requiring additional attention.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Provide the COO with clear visibility into progress, risks, workload, and outstanding decisions.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Initial Focus Areas:**

*(Initial assignments are expected to include)*

* **Supporting implementation of priority Operations initiatives within DANB’s strategic roadmap.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Establishing a consistent approach for planning, tracking, and reporting major Operations projects.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Supporting process improvement in selected candidate-facing areas, including Document Review, Client Services, and Certification Operations.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identifying opportunities to reduce manual work and improve workflows through process redesign and technology.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthening procedures, documentation, cross-training, and backup coverage.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Supporting implementation of approved changes to Operations roles, responsibilities, and processes.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Skills and Attributes:**

* **Strong organizational and project implementation skills with consistent attention to follow-through.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Ability to organize complex work into clear plans, responsibilities, timelines, and next steps.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.**
 --------------------------------------------------------
* **Effective facilitator who can help teams move from discussion to decisions and action.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong written and verbal communication skills.**
 ---------------------------------------------------
* **Collaborative and skilled at building productive relationships across teams and functions.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Able to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and recognize when issues require escalation.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Demonstrated ability to influence leaders and teams, establish accountability, and drive initiatives to completion without direct supervisory authority.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Practical approach to process improvement that avoids unnecessary complexity or bureaucracy.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Comfortable learning new systems, technologies, and operational processes.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Education & Qualifications:**

* **Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience required.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Minimum 8 years of progressively responsible experience in operations, project implementation, process improvement, or business operations, including demonstrated responsibility for leading complex, cross-functional initiatives required.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Demonstrated success leading initiatives from planning through implementation, including delivering measurable operational improvements.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience reviewing and improving business processes and workflows.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience supporting technology-enabled operational change preferred.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience in certification, credentialing, assessment, associations, nonprofits, healthcare, or another regulated environment is preferred.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Physical Demands:**

Required to sit for extended periods of time; may need to walk or stand in the course of work as well as light (20-30 lbs.) to medium (30-40 lbs.) levels of lifting of supplies and/or equipment.

**Work Environment:**

Work performed in an office environment, either onsite or offsite; periodic travel to be expected (<10%)

new_roles.title: Plant Manager - Manufacturing Operations
new_roles.description:
**Plant Manager - Manufacturing Operations**
--------------------------------------------

**Location:** Warren, MI 
**Work Model:** On-Site 
**Employment Type:** Full-Time 
**Reports To:**General Manager

**About SLPT**
--------------

**SLPT** is a manufacturing organization committed to delivering quality, reliability, and operational excellence for our customers. Located in Warren, Michigan, we take pride in building a culture where safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement drive everything we do.Our success starts with our people. We believe the best results come from empowered leaders who are willing to take ownership, develop talent, solve challenges, and continually raise the bar for performance. From the production floor to the leadership team, we foster an environment where employees are respected, supported, and encouraged to grow professionally.As we continue to invest in our operations, technology, and workforce, we are seeking leaders who are passionate about manufacturing excellence and motivated by the opportunity to make a measurable impact. The Plant Manager plays a critical role in shaping plant culture, driving continuous improvement, developing future leaders, and ensuring we consistently deliver exceptional results for our customers.

**Why Join SLPT?**
------------------

* Lead a high-impact manufacturing operation with significant responsibility and visibility.
* Influence plant strategy, operational performance, and business growth.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives that create meaningful results.
* Partner with a collaborative leadership team focused on innovation and operational excellence.
* Develop and mentor employees while building a culture of accountability, engagement, and success.
* Join an organization that values strong leadership, problem-solving, and professional growth.

**At SLPT, you'll have the opportunity to make a lasting impact on our people, our customers, and the future of our manufacturing operations.**

**About the Role**
------------------

Are you a hands-on manufacturing leader who thrives in a fast-paced production environment? We are seeking an experienced **Plant Manager**to lead all aspects of our Warren, Michigan manufacturing operation. In this role, you will oversee safety, quality, production, delivery performance, cost management, and employee development across a 24-hour operation.You will play a key role in driving operational excellence, implementing Lean Manufacturing initiatives, and developing high-performing teams while ensuring customer expectations and business objectives are consistently achieved. The ideal candidate brings strong leadership experience, a passion for continuous improvement, and a proven track record of delivering results in a multi-shift manufacturing environment.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Lead daily manufacturing operations across multiple shifts, ensuring achievement of safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost goals.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, urgency, and continuous improvement throughout the facility.
* Champion a zero-incident safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, environmental standards, customer requirements, and company policies.
* Oversee production, maintenance, engineering, quality, materials, warehousing, and logistics functions.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and operational excellence initiatives to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and maximize Operational Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
* Monitor plant financial performance, including labor costs, operating expenses, inventory, maintenance spending, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Support successful new product launches by partnering with engineering, quality, materials, and program management teams.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions to improve quality performance, reduce scrap and rework, and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Develop leaders and employees through coaching, succession planning, workforce development, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Utilize KPIs and operational metrics to identify opportunities, solve problems, and drive sustainable business improvements.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* 5+ years of experience as a Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or similar senior manufacturing leader.
* Proven success managing multi-shift manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve and sustain performance targets in safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost management.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets and operational expenses.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Automotive manufacturing experience.
* Experience supporting or maintaining IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 quality systems.
* Expertise in Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Kaizen, and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Certified Manufacturing Manager (CMfgM), PMP certification, or similar professional credentials.
* Master's degree in a related discipline.

Why you'll want to join our team:

* Lead a critical manufacturing operation with broad operational responsibility.
* Make a meaningful impact on plant performance, customer satisfaction, and company growth.
* Partner with an experienced leadership team in a collaborative environment.
* Drive operational excellence and shape the future of the facility.
* Develop and mentor the next generation of manufacturing leaders.
* Influence strategic initiatives, capital investments, and continuous improvement efforts.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive benefits and salary package being offered for this role.

This position is based on-site in Warren, MI and requires a strong presence on the production floor. Occasional travel may be required for customer meetings, supplier visits, training, and corporate initiatives.

identity_held_roles.title: Director of Quality
identity_held_roles.description:
**Director of Quality**

Job Type: Full time - Permanent

Location: Bethel, CT📍

A global, private equity backed medical device contract manufacturer is growing fast. With around 20 ISO 13485 certified sites, they make the precision components and sub-assemblies inside many of the world's leading medical devices, from laser-processed nitinol to thin-wall tubing. They're now looking for a Director of Quality to lead product quality and QMS compliance at one of their largest manufacturing sites.

**What you'll do:**

* Own manufacturing quality performance end to end, partnering with Operations to build quality into daily production
* Drive SPC, process capability and data-led problem solving directly on the manufacturing floor
* Lead validation strategy (IQ/OQ/PQ) and quality for New Product Introduction, from development into full-scale production
* Keep the QMS inspection-ready against ISO 13485 and 21 CFR 820, and host FDA inspections and ISO audits
* Be the senior quality contact for high-visibility customers and lead the supplier quality program
* Build, mentor and train a quality team in tools like pFMEA, Gage R&R, RCA and CAPA

**What you'll bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or management
* 7+ years in a medical device quality management role
* Hands-on manufacturing quality leadership in an ISO 13485 / 21 CFR 820 environment
* Experience hosting FDA inspections and ISO audits
* Lean and/or Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
* Contract manufacturing, finished device assembly, sterilization oversight, eQMS / ERP and CQA (preferred)
* Willingness to travel around 25%

This is a chance to lead quality at a flagship site within a high-growth medtech manufacturer, with real influence on how quality scales across a global network.

identity_held_roles.title: Regional Director, Quality Assurance
identity_held_roles.description:
As the Regional Director of Food Safety & Quality Assurance, you will be responsible for overseeing and ensuring the highest standards of food safety and quality across our operations in the United States and/or Canada. You will lead a team of professionals dedicated to maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies while driving continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and locations.
 
 
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Ensure individual plant teams are executing expected actions to meet corporate objectives
* Manages assigned plant FS-Q managers, and interacts with operations, R&D, and other relevant teams to implement the company’s strategic plan that encompasses all aspects of food safety and quality.
* Coaches plant FS-Q managers to ensure they perform according with strategic and the tactical/milestones necessary to achieve operational goals.
* Manages key customer (other than McDonald’s) QA relationships in conjunction with sales personnel.
* Work in partnership with direct manager to be in compliance with the regional McDonald’s FSQA expectations.
* Support and coach Plant FS-Q Managers for administering the department’s budget to ensure proper allocation of resources
* Assess and manages plant resources to ensure the QA and Food Safety KPI goals are achieved for the manufacturing plants under its purview.
* Ensures the food safety and quality of product and services by assessing compliance with product testing, performing internal assessments and audits of the FS-Q system and product lines, placing defective products on hold and taking corrective action
* Insures that all regulatory requirements are met including weights/measures, food safety, product claims, declarations, etc.
* Collaborates to standardize when required, QA policies/procedures to improve efficiency and reduce cost.
* Identifies and communicates FS- QA technologies to improve quality and reduce costs.
* Coaches and develops QA Managers to perform at a constantly exceptional level of performance, including but not limited to the sanitation program, compliance with the GFSI approved scheme audits; and when required acts as the plant’s SQF back-up Practitioner.
* Performs all other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Job Requirements**
**Education/Certifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, or related field (Master’s degree preferred).
* Minimum of ten (10) years of management experience including Quality Management Systems and/or Manufacturing experience.
* Prefer experience in a bakery/dry mixing (dry blending, frozen dough and baked goods) production environment.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Proficient use of computer, Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote), and other related applications or software.
* Demonstrated leadership experience and a sense of urgency and the drive to make continuous improvements
* Ability to operate at single and multi-site levels from management to “hands on” to accomplish tasks. Must be a “working manager.”
* Demonstrated ability to make and act on decisions while balancing speed, food safety, quality and risk.
* Strong background in sanitation principles and practices, GFSI approved schemes (SQF, BRC), HACCP, GMPs, Safety and SPC.
* Ability to think clearly and in a decisive manner while remaining calm under in pressure situations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work in a matrix environment and build strong relationships by being transparent, reliable, and accountable. Strong interpersonal skills backed-up by strong technical knowledge are critical to success in this role.
* Must have good writing skills and be able to communicate effectively with people at all levels of the company.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Manage multiple direct reports including but not limited to: Sr. Quality Assurance Manager, Quality Assurance Manager, Analyst.
* Work requires supervising and monitoring work performance of direct reports including making final decisions on hiring and disciplinary actions, evaluating program/work objectives and effectiveness, and realigning work and staffing assignments, as needed.
* Develop functional responsibilities of individuals that report to this position and ensure that best-in class output is created.

**Working Conditions And Physical Effort**

* Typical work in office environment but will spend periods of time in manufacturing plants which will have exposure to unusual elements, such as dirt, dust, fumes, odors, darkness and/or poor lighting, noise and vibration. Seasonal exposure to weather elements to include, but not limited to, extreme temperatures, wetness and humidity.
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.
* Substantial travel required (up to 70%) mostly in the North America.

**Expectations**

* Will demonstrate, promote, and exemplify the Company’s Core Values.

**About**
At C.H. Guenther, we value transparency in compensation. By providing the salary range for this role, we aim to promote fairness and help candidates make informed choices about their career. The salary range for this role is:
 
 
$142,500.00 - $228,000.00 USD
 
 
Actual compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, as well as geographic location.
 
 
**C.H. Guenther & Son will never offer or pay a wage or salary that is not compliant with applicable local, state, or federal pay laws, including minimum salary thresholds.**
We also offer a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, retirement savings options, flexible spending accounts, employee assistance programs, educational assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays.
 
 
**For Additional Information About Our Company, Go To Www.chg.com.**

Click here for more information regarding E-verify.
 
 
All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of the pre-employment screening process which includes a drug screen and review of criminal background and other records as required.

identity_held_roles.title: Head of Quality, Tate Americas
identity_held_roles.description:
**Job Type**
: Full-Time, Exempt
 
 
**Duration of role**
: Permanent
 
 
**Number of Position**
: 1
 
 
**Reporting to**
: Global Head of Compliance, Health & Safety and Quality
 
 
**Location**
: Columbia, MD
 
 
**About Us**
Tate Americas is a key business within Kingspan Data Solutions and is at the forefront of delivering integrated solutions to the rapidly expanding data centre market. We combine engineering expertise, advanced manufacturing and operational excellence to deliver complex, mission-critical projects for some of the world’s largest technology companies.
 
 
With significant investment and ambitious growth plans, Tate is evolving beyond traditional manufacturing to become a fully integrated solutions provider, offering customers a seamless delivery model from design and manufacturing through installation, commissioning and final handover.
 
 
**About The Role**
The US Head of Quality provides strategic leadership of the quality management function across all US manufacturing sites, ensuring products manufactured for data-centre applications consistently meet customer specifications, regulatory standards and internal quality benchmarks. This role is accountable for the deployment and governance of the Quality Management System (ISO 9001) across US operations, the development of Site Quality Managers, the integrity of supplier quality, and the effective close-out of quality non-conformances. Working closely with the US Head of Compliance, Site General Managers, Engineering and Supply Chain, the role holder will drive a culture of Zero Defects, First-Time-Right, and continuous improvement through Lean and Six Sigma methodologies. The role is a key member of the Global Quality, Compliance & Health & Safety leadership team and supports the delivery of the Quality & Compliance Pyramid across all US sites.
 
 
**What You’ll Do**
**Quality Management System Leadership**

* Own and continually improve the US Quality Management System aligned to ISO 9001 and customer-specific requirements.
* Ensure consistent deployment of quality procedures, work instructions, Inspection & Test Plans and control plans across all US sites.
* Provide quarterly reporting on QMS maturity, system performance and external audit readiness.
* Act as the principal quality signatory for US operations at Management Review.
* Ensure calibration programs, nonconforming material controls and change-control processes operate effectively across all sites.

**Site Quality Leadership & People Development**

* Lead, coach and develop Site Quality Managers, Quality Engineers and Quality Supervisors across US sites.
* Establish clear objectives, capability frameworks and development plans for the US quality community.
* Drive a culture of accountability, cross-site collaboration and high performance within the quality function.
* Own succession planning and technical competence development including AWS CWI, AWS CWS, AMPP, Six Sigma and internal auditor certifications.
* Champion a Zero Defects mindset and psychological safety for raising quality concerns.

**Supplier Quality & Incoming Material Control**

* Govern the supplier quality program across US operations, including supplier qualification, PPAP / First Article Inspection, supplier audits and Supplier Corrective Action Requests.
* Ensure robust incoming goods inspection, control of externally provided processes, and supplier performance reporting.
* Drive measurable reduction in supplier-driven non-conformances, line stops and rework cost.
* Partner with Supply Chain leadership to align supplier strategy, approved vendor lists and commercial terms with quality expectations.

**Welding, Fabrication & Coating Process Quality**

* Own the welding qualification program (WPS, PQR, WPQ) to AWS D1.1 / D1.3 and applicable customer standards for structural steel and hot aisle containment products.
* Own the coating qualification program to AMPP (NACE/SSPC) requirements, including surface preparation, DFT, adhesion and cure.
* Establish in-process inspection regimes (VT, DFT, dimensional) and statistical process control across fabrication, welding and paint processes.
* Ensure capable, calibrated inspection equipment, traceable measurement systems and robust Measurement System Analysis.

**Non-Conformance, CAPA & Continuous Improvement**

* Govern the US non-conformance and CAPA program, ensuring root cause rigor, effectiveness verification and closure discipline.
* Drive Lean, 5S and Six Sigma improvement activities focused on defect prevention and reduction of Cost of Poor Quality.
* Establish and track regional quality KPIs and performance dashboards: DPPM, first-pass yield, customer complaints, scrap and rework cost, audit score.
* Lead quality improvement initiatives linked to the Quality & Compliance Pyramid Action Plan.

**Customer Quality & External Audit Face-off**

* Serve as senior quality representative for hyperscale customer audits, Factory Acceptance Tests and customer site visits.
* Manage customer quality escalations, 8D responses and corrective-action delivery with rigor and pace.
* Ensure customer-specific requirements are captured in quality plans, control plans and inspection regimes at site level.
* Partner with Sales, Commercial and Estimating teams on quality-related tender qualification and customer onboarding.

**Governance & Reporting**

* Provide monthly quality performance reports to the Global Head of Quality, Compliance & Health & Safety.
* Support Management Reviews, internal audits and external ISO 9001 surveillance and recertification audits.
* Ensure quality risks are identified, quantified and escalated appropriately within the US operation.
* Maintain regional ownership of Management of Change impacting product quality, process qualification or inspection regimes.

*Additional Expectations*

* Remain compliant with the Code of Conduct and Policies which includes the Kingspan Group Compliance Policy.
* Ensure that all duties related to product compliance are adhered to in accordance with the Product Compliance Policy, Laws, Regulations, and market demands.
* Responsible for all tasks to achieve compliance goals and demands of the Compliance Management System.
* Must raise concerns related to the Compliance Management System to their supervisor, manager, or any member of the Leadership Team, or through the confidential whistle blower service.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management or related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of progressive quality experience in a manufacturing environment, including at least 5 years leading multi-site operations.
* Proven leadership of Quality Managers or equivalent senior roles across multiple sites.
* Lead auditor qualification in ISO 9001 required; additional qualification in ISO 37301 or ISO 14001 desirable.
* Deep experience of welded and fabricated product quality; AWS QC1 Certified Welding Inspector certification preferred.
* Practical experience with coating qualification to AMPP (NACE/SSPC) standards desirable.
* Certified Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent continuous improvement qualification.
* Strong working knowledge of PPAP, APQP, control plans, PFMEA, SPC and Measurement System Analysis.
* Experience managing quality for hyperscale data-center customers, OEMs or comparable demanding clients.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, stakeholder management and decision-making skills.
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly to US manufacturing sites.

**What You’ll Get**

* This role is eligible for a discretionary bonus.
* Career Scope and Advancement: As we grow, new positions and career opportunities arise, offering accelerated paths for the right candidates, locally and globally.
* World of Wellness Philosophy: We empower you to take charge of your health and well-being. You’ll have access to a wide range of medical, dental, and vision benefits, along with personalized guidance from a “Health Advocate.” We also offer other supplemental options, including 401k, legal, disability, and theft insurance, to ensure your financial wellness.
* Corporate Social Responsibility: Through Planet Passionate we are determined to reduce our manufacturing carbon (CO2e) emissions to as close to zero as technically possible, together with halving carbon intensity in our primary supply chain. We are very involved in our community, and you will have ample opportunities to support us in creating a better world.
* Skills Development: Given the dynamic pace of our business and a strong collaborative environment, your new role will be diverse and multifaceted – allowing you to be more versatile and develop a broader skill set.
* Mentorship and development: At Tate, we don’t believe in hierarchy; we work together as one team for one common goal. You will have access and exposure to our senior leaders and experts for learning in your role, and additional mentorship for the future.
* Culture: We have a great team of culture, highly collaborative, supportive, and social skills. Together we innovate, collaborate, take ownership, and strive for excellence.

Stay connected with us on LinkedIn for insights into life at Tate. Join us in our mission to make a difference through exceptional solutions.
 
 
Tate Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of post-offer requirements, including a background check and drug screening, in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.
