**Brief Description**
**About Us**
At
**FreshDirect**
, we are reinventing the grocery experience.
  
  
Since day one, our mission has been simple: bring the best, freshest food directly from the farm to people’s homes — faster, fresher, and smarter than anyone else.
  
  
We’re not just a food company. We’re a technology-powered, customer-obsessed team building one of the most innovative end-to-end food supply chains in the industry. From proprietary routing systems to our state-of-the-art fulfillment center, every part of our business is designed to deliver unmatched quality, convenience, and care.
  
  
We partner directly with farmers, fishermen, and artisans to source the highest quality ingredients — then use smart data, automation, and logistics to deliver them at peak freshness.
  
  
It’s grocery shopping reimagined — and we’re just getting started.
  
  
If you’re passionate about innovation, care deeply about what people eat, and want to help build the future of food, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
**The Role**
The Senior Director of Operations & Transformation is responsible for driving operational excellence, strategic initiatives, and enterprise-wide transformation efforts across the organization. This leader will partner with executive stakeholders to improve business performance, optimize processes, and implement scalable solutions that support growth, efficiency, and customer experience.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the role will lead cross-functional projects that enhance organizational effectiveness and drive measurable business impact.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead high-impact transformation and continuous improvement initiatives across the business.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, productivity, and scalability.
* Partner with leaders across Operations, Supply Chain, Transportation, Manufacturing, Technology, and other functions to drive performance improvements.
* Establish and track KPIs, leveraging data and analytics to support decision-making and business outcomes.
* Develop and implement standardized processes, governance, and best practices.
* Lead complex cross-functional projects from strategy through execution.
* Drive change management efforts to ensure successful adoption of new processes and initiatives.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on operational strategy, performance, risks, and opportunities.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years of leadership experience in operations, transformation, continuous improvement, consulting, or a related field.
* Proven success leading large-scale operational and business transformation initiatives.
* Strong people leadership skills with experience building, developing, and motivating high-performing teams.
* Strong project management, change management, and stakeholder leadership skills.
* Experience driving process improvement and operational excellence in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a data-driven approach.
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

**Our Values at FreshDirect**
We live these values every day:
  
  
**A Passion for our customers**
Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We listen, innovate, and act quickly to exceed expectations with every order and interaction.
  
  
**One team, one mission**
Everyone contributes & every role matters. We break silos, lift each other up, and share a relentless focus on delivering results. That way, we win together.
  
  
**Delivering excellence, every time**
We take pride in the quality of our food, service, and the experience we create. Our team goes above and beyond to earn trust and guarantee 100% freshness.
  
  
**Act with integrity**
We operate with honesty, respect, and accountability in how we treat our customers, teammates, and partners. We own our outcomes and always do what’s right, even when no one is watching.
  
  
**Make fast, bold decisions**
We challenge the status quo, embrace technology, and take smart risks to build a better future. At the same time, we stay true to our NYC roots and care for our community.
  
  
**We love food. Yes, literally all of us.**
**What You’ll Love About Working Here**

* A fast-paced, innovative environment where ideas turn into action
* Opportunities for growth — many of our leaders have risen through the ranks
* Direct impact on how thousands of customers experience food every day

**Salary**
$170,000-$200,000
  
  
**Total Rewards & Benefits**

* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits
* PTO, Safe & Sick Time, and Paid Holidays
* Medical, Vision, Dental, and Voluntary Disability coverage
* 401(k) with employer match and Life Insurance
* State-of-the-art Bronx campus with on-site basketball court, cafeteria, and employee market
* Onsite FREE parking
* FREE employee shuttle bus service from nearby Subway station
* Training, leadership development, and tuition discount at local colleges
* 20% employee discount on FreshDirect online orders and Brooklyn wine store
* Minimum 50% employee discount at our onsite employee market
* Mobile phone discounts through partnerships with T-Mobile and Verizon
* Gym membership discounts through NYSC

**Our Culture**
We embrace an in-office culture, composed of individuals who thrive on the collaboration and energy that comes from working together in a shared space. We are looking for people who excel in this environment, where physical presence enhances connections and engagement. At FreshDirect, we've created an environment that thrives on teamwork, where associates can innovate, grow, and have successful careers. Many of our leaders have successfully come up through our ranks. Because of our team's extraordinary efforts, we are a leading innovator in the e-commerce and grocery industries.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Fresh Direct, LLC and its affiliates do not discriminate against applicants or employees because of their race, color, citizenship status, national origin, ancestry, gender, disability, sexual orientation, age, religion, creed, marital status, veteran status, domestic violence victim status, political affiliation, or any other factor protected by federal, state, or local law.

They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of individuals in this position. Position expectations may be subject to change as the needs of the organization changes.

**About Us:**
BW Papersystems, part of the Barry-Wehmiller Group, builds capital equipment that transforms paper into products for consumers - every day, around the world. We offer innovative technologies, service and parts, and years of global experience in corrugating, finishing; slitting and packaging; stationery; bookbinding and security documents. Customers rely on our machines to produce and convert items such as corrugated boxes, folding cartons, passports, notebooks, copy paper, board, and coated and other specialty papers. For more information, visit bwpapersystems.com.
  
  
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
  
  
**Job Description:**
The Director of Quality will be responsible for developing the overall Quality Improvement Strategy and lead the team in the cross-functional adoption and execution of that strategy. In this critical role, the Director of Quality will be the leader in developing and maintaining a quality management system to improve operating efficiency, quality and productivity in operations, to improve customer satisfaction, and to increase profitability in a safe working environment.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Develop the overall Quality Improvement Strategy and lead the management team in the cross-functional adoption and execution of that strategy.
* Develop and maintain a business/quality management system to improve operating efficiency, quality and productivity in operations, to improve customer satisfaction and increase profitability in a safe working environment within the local business.
* Continuously assess the overall Quality Management System, Quality Plan and Quality Organization to determine priorities for quality improvement.
* Establish the key improvement priorities, and using a strategy deployment approach, develop and execute a cross-functional, strategic action plan to drive improvement.
* Identify the leading sources of customer dissatisfaction.
* Determine the underlying causes and develop/execute strategies to eliminate those causes.
* Determine the true, systemic root causes of internal failure and Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ).
* Execute a strategy consisting of well-planned and executed preventive actions that reduce COPQ and other forms of waste.
* Drive improvements in process quality, production efficiency, and the elimination of the factors that drive variability and unforeseen disruptions.
* Drive a strategy that incorporates standard work, effective training, and recurring process audits to ensure process discipline.
* Establish and maintain appropriate KPIs that provide objective evidence of improvement
* Participate in training and coaching teams in the standard quality improvement approach and quality management standard requirements to develop organizational capability.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, quality, continuous improvement, or related field.
* 10+ years of professional experience leading a Quality Organization in capital equipment manufacturing environment.
* Experience with the execution of continuous improvement methodology such as Operational Excellence, Lean Manufacturing, Strategy Deployment, etc.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES:**

* Requires the ability to independently resolve complex problems.
* Requires ability to manage a skilled and diverse staff, communicate effectively, represent the organization, act decisively, and influence decisions of senior managers and customers.
* Requires foresight to anticipate problems and recognize opportunities for cost-effectively improving operations.

**COMPETENCIES**

* Customer Focus – Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
* Instills Trust – Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
* Drives Results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
* Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
* Optimizes Work Processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Ensures Accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
* Collaborates – Building partnerships and collaborating with others to meet shared objectives.
* Decision Quality – Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

*The approximate pay range for this position is $155,000 to $210,000 base salary. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to background, knowledge, skills, and abilities as well as geographic location of the position.*
*At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.*
Barry-Wehmiller is an equal opportunity employer. M/F/D/V This organization uses E-Verify.
  
  
Applicants may be subject to pre-employment screening which may include drug screening, reference checks, employment verifications, background screening and/or skills assessments.
  
  
**Company:**
BW Papersystems

existing_roles.description:
**Responsibilities**
****Position Summary****
The Director of Operational Excellence & Assurance owns two closely linked functions at Related Digital: driving continuous improvement across data center operations, and independently assessing and auditing operational, safety, and quality performance against the Related Digital EHS Program Manual, site standard operating procedures, and applicable regulatory and industry standards. This includes auditing facility management partner performance against contractual SLAs and KPIs, and supporting Related Digital’s SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification programs. This role designs and executes the internal audit and assessment program, verifies that field practice matches documented procedure, drives corrective action to closure, and partners with site and regional leadership to convert audit findings into lasting process improvement. The role carries Stop Work Authority and reports significant findings directly to site and operations leadership.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
****Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement****

* Lead site and portfolio level continuous improvement initiatives to improve the safety, reliability, quality, and efficiency of data center operations.
* Establish and maintain standardized operating procedures, playbooks, and best-practice sharing across sites.
* Define, track, and report key performance indicators (KPIs) for operational performance, safety, and compliance; identify trends and improvement opportunities.
* Facilitate root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) processes for operational, safety, and quality events, consistent with the Incident Investigation & Root Cause Analysis Program.
* Partner with Engineering, Facilities, and EHS teams to standardize processes across the portfolio and support new site commissioning and operational readiness.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement, change management, and operational discipline among site teams.
* Monitor energy performance, including PUE, against site design targets and drive corrective action for deviations.

****Operational Assessment & Internal Audit****

* Design, own, and execute the annual internal audit and operational assessment plan across all Related Digital sites, covering all EHS programs, life-safety systems, critical facility operations, and quality/process compliance.
* Conduct on-site operational assessments and compliance audits against the Program Manuals, site SOPs, inspection/checklist templates, and applicable regulatory or industry standards (OSHA, NFPA, ANSI, Uptime Institute Tier Standards, SOC2, ISO 9001/45001/14001).
* Evaluate the completeness and currency of site-level checklists, inspection logs, JHAs/AHAs, and training records against the EHS Training Requirements Matrix.
* Document audit findings, assign risk ratings, and issue formal assessment reports to site and regional leadership.
* Track corrective action plans (CAPs) to closure, verifying effectiveness through follow-up audits.
* Maintain audit program documentation, evidence, and records consistent with the Records Management & Retention Program.
* Support external audits, customer/tenant due-diligence assessments, and regulatory inspections as the internal subject matter expert.
* Audit physical security programs, covering access control, credentialing, and key management.
* Audit commissioning and construction documentation, such as MOPs, RCAs, and general contractor turnover packages, for completeness before closeout.

****Facility Management Partner & Vendor Oversight****

* Audit facility management partner performance against contractual SLAs and KPIs, covering maintenance completion, staffing, and site inspections; validate SLA credits using EPMS, BMS, CMMS, and incident log data.
* Audit facility management partner Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery programs, and verify adherence to change management and work notification protocols.
* Support evaluation of facility management partner RFP responses and subcontractor compliance.
* Review partner markups, pricing transparency, and preferred vendor compliance.
* Support transition and exit audits when facility management partners change.

****Governance, Training & Reporting****

* Maintain and continuously improve the internal audit methodology, scoring rubrics, and assessment tools.
* Deliver periodic (e.g., quarterly) operational excellence and audit performance reporting to executive leadership, including site scorecards and trend analysis.
* Partner with the Site EHS Manager and Safety Training Program owners to close training and competency gaps identified during assessments.
* Provide coaching and calibration to site leadership on self-assessment practices, audit readiness, and continuous improvement tools.
* Participate in incident investigation reviews where root causes point to systemic operational or procedural gaps.
* Lead Related Digital’s SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 audit cycles, including evidence collection and coordination with external auditors.
* Review facility management partner SOC 2 and ISO 27001 attestation reports where relevant to Related Digital’s compliance obligations.

**Qualifications**
****Educational and Certifications****
**Minimum Education (Required):**

* Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Occupational Safety & Health, Business Administration, Operations Management, Quality Management, or another related technical or business discipline.
* Equivalent experience in lieu of degree: an Associate’s degree plus a minimum of four (4) additional years of directly relevant operational excellence, quality assurance, or internal audit experience, or a high school diploma/GED plus eight (8) years of directly relevant experience, may be considered in place of the bachelor’s degree requirement.

**Preferred Education:**

* Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA), Engineering Management, Occupational Safety, Quality Systems, or a related field.
* Formal coursework or certificate training in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or internal audit methodology.

**Required and Preferred Certifications:**

* OSHA 30-Hour General Industry or Construction certification.
* Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or CISA.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt.
* Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Associate Safety Professional (ASP), or Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH).
* Data center industry certification (e.g., CDCP/CDCS/CDCE, CDCAP, or Uptime Institute Accredited Tier Specialist).

****Experience****

* Minimum 7–10 years of progressive experience in operations, quality assurance, EHS, or internal audit roles.
* At least 3 years of that experience in a data center, other critical facility, manufacturing, or industrial operating environment.
* Minimum 3 years leading or managing an internal audit, quality assurance, or operational assessment program.
* Demonstrated track record designing and executing continuous improvement initiatives with measurable, documented results.
* Experience auditing against OSHA/ANSI/NFPA standards, SOC, ISO 9001/45001/14001, IATF 16949, or Uptime Institute Tier Standards is strongly preferred given the mission-critical facility environment.
* Supervisory or project leadership experience, including leading cross-functional teams without direct authority.

****Skills & Core Competencies****

* Strong analytical and root-cause problem-solving skills; able to synthesize audit data into clear, actionable insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to present findings to site staff, peers, and executive leadership with equal clarity.
* High attention to detail balanced with pragmatic judgment on risk prioritization.
* Proficiency with audit/GRC software, statistical and process tools (e.g., Minitab, Excel), and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is a plus.
* Comfortable exercising Stop Work Authority and holding site teams accountable with professionalism and tact.
* Working knowledge of critical facility systems (electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety) is preferred.
* Self-directed, able to plan and manage a multi-site audit calendar with minimal oversight.

****Work Environment & Physical Demands****

* Ability to walk extended distances across large facility footprints, climb stairs and ladders, and work in mechanical/electrical rooms with variable noise and temperature.
* Occasional lifting of up to 25 lbs.
* Ability to sit, stand, and use a computer for extended periods when preparing audit reports and analysis.

****Travel Requirements****

* Up to 40–50% domestic travel across the Related Digital site portfolio can be required, including occasional multi-day site visits. A valid driver’s license is required; ability to travel by air and a US passport is required.

**Overview**
**Why Related Digital?**
Formed in 1972, Related is the most prominent privately-owned real estate firm in the United States. Headquartered in New York City, the company has offices and major developments across the world. Related owns and manages a premier portfolio of assets valued at over $70 billion, including the 28-acre Hudson Yards neighborhood on Manhattan’s West Side.
  
  
Related believes in investing in its talent and cultivates a positive, team-oriented environment where every voice is valued. Employees are encouraged to boldly take on new challenges, transcend the status quo, and demonstrate strong entrepreneurial spirit. In its relentless commitment to excellence, Related fosters an innovative approach so that team members can positively impact the communities in which they conduct business.
  
  
Founded by Related Companies, Related Digital is a leading vertically integrated data center development and investment platform that partners with leading technology companies to provide best-in-class digital infrastructure and holistic energy solutions through responsible, community-centered development. Related Digital currently has $55B in active data center development and construction underway representing 6GW of capacity, with projects in Ontario, Wyoming, Michigan, Missouri, Illinois and Texas.
  
  
Its vertically integrated platform encompasses site acquisition, entitlements, supply chain procurement, steel fabrication, construction management, and utility-scale energy solutions, providing hyperscalers with differentiated, end-to-end execution. Learn more at related-digital.com .
  
  
For information about how we use your personal information, including information submitted for career opportunities, please review our Privacy Policy at https://www.related.com/privacy-policy .

Build Your Career as a Director, Operational Excellence & Business Enablement!
  
  
At BlueLinx, our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to ensuring our team members can build job security, enhance their skills, and make meaningful contributions. We deliver the building blocks to better lives.
  
  
Join us and be part of a company that values its people and strives to make a positive impact on the industry!

**Comprehensive Benefits Include**

* Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription
* 401(k) with company match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Life Insurance
* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and 8 Company Holidays
* Career Growth: Opportunity to develop and advance your career with a leading building products distributor.

**Job Summary**
The Director, Operational Excellence & Business Enablement leads the development and deployment of the BlueLinx operating system across the branch network. This role converts operational strategy, performance data, and technology investments into standard processes, measurable performance improvement, and sustained branch adoption. Reporting to the Sr. Director, Logistics Systems, the Director partners across Regional Operations, Branch Operations, Commercial, Inventory, Finance, Human Resources, Safety, and Information Technology to improve customer service, labor productivity, cost performance, process consistency, and the adoption of new operating capabilities.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Understands the company’s vision, mission, and strategy; translates business and functional objectives into clear Operational Excellence priorities and measurable outcomes.
* Leads the enterprise operations performance-management process, including metric definitions, monthly reporting, trend analysis, performance reviews, corrective-action follow-up, and continuous improvement of dashboards and reporting methods.
* Owns governance and continuous improvement for On-Time and In-Full delivery performance, including failure-reason categories, functional ownership, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and branch adoption.
* Develops and maintains the BlueLinx branch operating system, including standard work, daily and weekly management routines, branch assessment methods, operating playbooks, and sustainment reviews.
* Leads the operational labor-management strategy, including common productivity measures, labor standards, reporting requirements, and branch improvement plans developed in partnership with Regional Operations and Human Resources.
* Serves as the business process and adoption leader for operations, logistics and warehouse technology-enabled improvement initiatives, including transportation, warehouse management, scanning, labeling, automation, data, and artificial intelligence capabilities.
* Translates operational needs into clear business requirements; leads current-state and future-state process design, operational pilots, field testing, readiness, rollout planning, training, adoption measurement, and post-launch sustainment.
* Maintains the enterprise Operational Excellence project portfolio and prioritizes work based on customer impact, business value, risk, available resources, and alignment with company strategy.
* Partners with Finance to validate expected and realized financial benefits, including direct savings, cost avoidance, productivity improvements, and working-capital opportunities.
* Provides structured problem-solving support for complex, cross-functional, or recurring branch issues while ensuring the accountable function retains ownership of execution and sustainment.
* Builds organizational capability through practical training and coaching in standard work, root-cause analysis, process improvement, visual management, and leader operating routines.
* Identifies proven branch practices and creates repeatable methods to scale those practices across regions and locations.
* Builds strong working relationships with regional, branch, and functional leadership; influences decisions through clear data, practical recommendations, and disciplined follow-through.
* Leads and develops assigned Operational Excellence, analytics, process improvement, or industrial engineering resources and actively supports talent acquisition and succession planning.

existing_roles.description:
**About Tutor**
---------------

We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business.

Tutor Intelligence is changing that.

Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence.

Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.

Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

**The Role**
------------

As Head of Quality, you’ll lead quality as a function, alongside the Head of Manufacturing. The quality engineers and the quality manager report to you, and you’ll grow the team from there. This is a building role: incoming inspection, supplier controls and failure analysis are being put in place now, and you’ll turn them into a system that holds as production grows.

You’ll report to the CTO. As our operations organization grows, you’ll report to its leader. This is an onsite role in Watertown, MA.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* The quality system, and the quality targets the company holds itself to
* Supplier quality across our supply base
* Product safety certifications, and a quality record customers and certifying bodies can verify
* The authority to hold any shipment that isn’t right
* Growing the quality team

**Requirements**
----------------

* Led a quality function at a company that builds complex electromechanical hardware in volume
* Built or rebuilt a quality system and taken it through ISO 9001 or an equivalent certification
* Ran supplier quality across a supply base, including overseas suppliers
* Taken a product through product safety certification
* Built and led a team of quality engineers and managers
* Make decisions from data, and hold a shipment when the data says so

**Nice to have:**

* Robotics, automation, vehicles or capital equipment
* Reliability engineering methods: life testing, failure rate analysis, design reviews
* Building quality data and tooling that other teams use
* Experience with manufacturing execution systems

**What to Expect**
------------------

We want you to know exactly what to expect. Here’s what our interview process typically looks like:

* **Recruiter interview:** A conversation with a member of our Recruiting team about your background and what you’re looking for.
* **Hiring manager interview:** A deeper conversation with the hiring manager about the role and your experience.
* **Onsite:** A presentation with the team, 1:1s with key team members, and a tour of our facility.

Some roles include additional steps, such as a technical assessment or take-home exercise. If yours does, we’ll let you know up front. Throughout the process, we’ll aim to keep you updated at each step as quickly as possible.

**Why Tutor?**
--------------

Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable.

Our team of 160+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.

**Benefits**
------------

We take care of our team so they can do their best work. At Tutor, you’ll get:

* Fully employer-covered health insurance, so you’re protected without the premium.
* A managed 401(k) to help you plan for the future.
* Generous time off: unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full-time salaried employees, and 16+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees.
* Regular in-office meals and team social events throughout the year.

As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond.

Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

Compensation Range: $220K - $280K

**Director of Quality**
=======================

**Colorado Springs, CO | Full-Time | On-Site**

### **Lead Quality. Develop People. Protect the Mission.**

At Cogitic Corporation, quality isn't just a department, it's critical to our mission. We manufacture precision components supporting the U.S. Navy and national defense programs, where accuracy, accountability, and reliability are non-negotiable.

We're seeking an experienced, technically strong Director of Quality to lead our Quality Management System (QMS), develop our inspection team, and drive a culture of operational excellence.

**This is not a desk-only leadership position.** We're looking for someone who can think strategically, lead confidently, and remain technically engaged. The right person is just as comfortable leading an audit or developing a quality strategy as they are reviewing a complex drawing, troubleshooting an inspection challenge, or supporting CMM programming.

If you're a quality leader who takes ownership, develops people, and believes in getting things right the first time, we want to hear from you.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**Quality Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Quality and Inspection team, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and opportunities for growth.
* Build a high-performing team that values technical excellence, collaboration, continuous learning, and proactive problem-solving.
* Balance strategic quality initiatives with daily operational priorities to support production and delivery commitments.

**Quality Management & Compliance**

* Own, maintain, and continuously improve Cogitic's QMS, ensuring compliance with applicable customer, regulatory, and contractual requirements.
* Lead internal, customer, supplier, and external audits, ensuring findings are addressed effectively and on time.
* Drive corrective action efforts, including root-cause analysis, corrective action implementation, and verification of effectiveness.
* Ensure quality processes support traceability, documentation accuracy, product conformance, and audit readiness.

**Technical Quality & Inspection**

* Oversee inspection planning, testing, and product acceptance for complex, precision-machined components.
* Apply advanced knowledge of engineering drawings, GD&T, specifications, and dimensional inspection methods.
* Provide hands-on technical support with inspection processes, CMM programming, measurement techniques, and complex quality challenges.
* Maintain oversight of measurement and test equipment (M&TE), calibration programs, and inspection equipment readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve inspection efficiency, accuracy, and first-pass quality.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Mission Assurance, and Supply Chain to resolve quality concerns and execute customer requirements.
* Lead supplier quality activities, including qualification, performance monitoring, audits, and compliance with flow-down requirements.
* Establish and monitor meaningful quality KPIs to identify trends, reduce defects, and drive measurable improvements.
* Leverage ProShop ERP, quality data, and standard quality tools to strengthen processes, reporting, and operational visibility.
* Promote a proactive quality culture focused on prevention, accountability, and doing things right the first time.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Quality, Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, Welding Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing quality experience, including hands-on machining, inspection, or precision manufacturing exposure.
* Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and developing technical quality or inspection personnel.
* Strong understanding of AS9100 quality management systems, audit processes, corrective actions, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Advanced ability to interpret complex engineering drawings, GD&T, specifications, and dimensional tolerances.
* Proven ability to investigate quality issues, identify root causes, implement sustainable solutions, and hold teams accountable.
* Strong technical aptitude, analytical judgment, communication skills, and ability to balance competing priorities.
* Proficiency with ERP systems, Microsoft Office, and technical quality software.
* U.S. citizenship and ability to successfully complete required background screening and meet applicable security clearance eligibility requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting U.S. Navy, NAVSEA, nuclear, or other highly regulated defense manufacturing programs.
* Hands-on experience with CMM programming, inspection planning, and precision measurement equipment.
* Experience managing calibration and M&TE programs.
* Working knowledge of ProShop ERP and SolidWorks or similar CAD software.
* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), ASME GD&T certification, or comparable credentials.
* Experience with supplier quality management, customer audits, and complex contractual quality requirements.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

In this role, success means more than passing audits. You'll be expected to:

* Build a capable, accountable Quality team that operates with confidence and consistency.
* Maintain an effective, audit-ready QMS that supports the business rather than slowing it down.
* Reduce recurring quality issues through effective root-cause analysis and lasting corrective actions.
* Improve inspection efficiency, product conformance, and on-time execution.
* Develop stronger cross-functional partnerships and establish clear ownership of quality throughout the organization.

**Who Thrives at Cogitic?**
---------------------------

Our strongest leaders demonstrate our core values of **Performance, Character, Courage, Development, and Initiative.**

We're looking for someone who takes ownership instead of assigning blame, addresses challenges directly, coaches rather than simply directs, and understands that quality and operational performance must work together.

You should be comfortable in a growing organization where priorities evolve, expectations are high, and your leadership can make a meaningful impact.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

**Compensation:** $150k - 200K annually, based on experience and qualifications.

At Cogitic, we believe in taking care of our team and providing opportunities to grow. Our benefits include:

* **Medical Insurance:** Competitive medical coverage with employer contributions toward premiums.
* **Dental Insurance:** Employer contributes 20% toward dental premiums.
* **Vision Insurance:** Voluntary vision coverage.
* **401(k) Retirement Plan:** Opportunity to save and plan for your future.
* **Life Insurance:** Employer-paid basic life and AD&D coverage.
* **Additional Coverage:** Voluntary life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability options.
* **Paid Time Off:** PTO and 10 company-observed holidays.
* **Professional Development:** Opportunities for continued learning, technical development, and leadership growth.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**
----------------------------

If you're an experienced quality leader who enjoys building strong teams, solving complex manufacturing challenges, and supporting work that matters, we'd love to connect.

**Apply today and help shape the future of Quality at Cogitic Corporation.**

Advanced technology, a world-class clinical development organization, and state-of-the-art facilities: these and other resources empower us to innovate and touch the lives of more and more patients. It’s our work, our passion, and our legacy. We invite you to join us.
  
  
**Hybrid:** 3-days per week on-site
  
Employee Value Proposition
  
​​​​​​At Taiho Oncology, the compassion we practice for our patients extends to our team, empowering and motivating them to do their best work for those who need it most. This is an exciting opportunity to lead critical Quality systems in a dynamic, collaborative, and global cross-functional environment.
  
  
**Position Summary:**  
​​​​​​​​​The Director, QA Ops – Document, Training & Records Management is responsible for the strategy, governance, and execution of Taiho Oncology’s controlled document management, GxP training management, archival, and records-retention programs. This position leads the team responsible for day-to-day activities in MasterControl and establishes scalable processes, system capabilities, and governance that support current operations and Taiho’s future business plans. The Director partners with Quality, functional leaders, Information Technology, system owners, affiliates, and global stakeholders to maintain compliant, efficient, and inspection-ready programs.
  
  
**Performance Objectives:**  
**​​​​Strategy, Governance and Leadership:**  

* Develop and execute the long-term strategy and operating model for controlled document management, GxP training management, archival, and records retention.
* Translate Taiho’s future plans into scalable processes, systems, governance, resources, and program roadmaps.
* Establish policies, standards, performance measures, risk controls, and continuous-improvement priorities and provide recommendations to senior management.
* Lead harmonization and standardization of document and training practices across TOI and applicable affiliates and global stakeholders.
* Manage, coach, and develop the team responsible for document, training, archival, and records-management activities; maintain clear roles, capacity, cross-training, succession planning, and business continuity.

**MasterControl and Quality System Oversight:**  

* Provide business ownership, strategic direction, and governance for MasterControl document and training capabilities.
* Oversee administration of document workflows, courses, curricula, assignments, job codes, user accounts, metadata, effective dates, access, archival status, and related records.

* Evaluate and implement capabilities needed to align MasterControl with business growth, affiliate integration, data integrity, inspection readiness, and future quality-system plans.
* Ensure procedures, user guidance, training materials, reports, and support mechanisms remain current and effective.

**Controlled Document Management:**  

* Oversee the lifecycle management of controlled policies, standard operating procedures, work instructions, forms, guidance documents, and other GxP documents from creation through retirement and archival.
* Establish standards for templates, numbering, naming, metadata, review and approval, effective dates, revision history, periodic review, document relationships, distribution, and supersession.
* Ensure controlled documents receive appropriate Quality and administrative review and that document owners resolve quality, workflow, implementation, and timeliness issues.
* Lead periodic assessment and cleanup of the controlled-document environment, including obsolete, duplicate, or floating documents and attachments.
* Provide document-management leadership and evidence support during audits, inspections, due diligence, and compliance reviews.

**GxP Training Management:**  

* Establish the strategy and governance framework for GxP training across TOI and applicable affiliates.
* Ensure training requirements, curricula, courses, job codes, assignments, and records are aligned with job responsibilities, controlled documents, organizational changes, and compliance obligations.
* Oversee onboarding, role changes, transfers, leaves of absence, and separation processes as they affect training requirements and records.
* Ensure required training is assigned, completed, tracked, documented, reported, and retained; monitor compliance and escalate material risks.
* Oversee new-hire Quality training, document creator/revisor training, instructor-led training, read-and-understand activities, assessments, and other approved training methods.
* Lead improvements that strengthen training effectiveness, learner experience, role alignment, reporting, and inspection readiness.

**Archival and Records Retention:**  

* Develop and oversee the strategy for identification, transfer, storage, protection, retrieval, retention, disposition, and migration of applicable quality records.
* Partner with Legal, Information Technology, Records Management, functional stakeholders, and Quality Assurance to establish and maintain appropriate retention requirements and controls.
* Ensure electronic and physical records, as applicable, remain authentic, complete, readable, secure, traceable, accessible, and retrievable throughout the retention period.
* Identify and remediate risks involving legacy records, decentralized repositories, inconsistent practices, obsolete formats, or system migrations.
* Maintain inspection readiness; support audits and regulatory inspections; lead remediation, CAPA, and risk-management activities related to assigned processes.
* Establish and report metrics for document timeliness, training compliance, overdue activities, processing volume, archival status, system performance, and program risk.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Education/Certification Requirements:**  

* ​​​​​​​​Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, quality, regulatory affairs, information management, business, or a related discipline required; advanced degree preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**  

* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other regulated life-sciences industry.
* Significant experience in Quality Assurance, controlled document management, GxP training, archival, records retention, and regulated quality systems.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams and complex cross-functional programs; experience supporting regulatory inspections and audits required.
* Experience with MasterControl document and training modules, validated computerized systems, and system implementations, upgrades, or migrations strongly preferred.
* Comprehensive knowledge of GxP quality-system principles and regulated document, training, archival, records-retention, and data-integrity practices.
* Demonstrated ability to establish strategy, governance, and future-state plans while ensuring effective and timely operational execution.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, delegation, succession planning, stakeholder management, and change-leadership skills.
* Strong project, program, risk, and regulatory management abilities, including development of metrics, management reporting, and sustainable process improvements.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, analytical, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and communicate effectively at all organizational levels.

At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.
  
  
**Job Description**

**EXAMPLE RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Set the global Digital Quality strategy and roadmap**
  + Define the target state, strategic themes, capability model, and multi-year roadmap for Digital Quality.
  + Maintain a portfolio of initiatives aligned with Quality objectives, regulatory priorities, enterprise architecture, and available investment.
  + Establish measurable outcomes, including compliance effectiveness, cycle-time reduction, right-first-time performance, user adoption, data quality, and realized benefits.
* **Lead end-to-end Quality process mapping and optimization**
  + Map current- and future-state processes across sites, regions, and GxP domains, including roles, decisions, controls, systems, data, handoffs, pain points, and performance measures.
  + Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, digitize, automate, or retire processes before selecting technology.
  + Maintain process, capability, system, and data maps to support investment decisions, integration planning, and global standardization.
  + Partner with process owners to define requirements, target operating models, controls, and adoption plans.
* **Assess and recommend new digital tools**
  + Establish a consistent intake and assessment method for digital tools, platforms, automation, analytics, and AI use cases.
  + Evaluate intended use, user need, business value, GxP impact, patient and product risk, data integrity, privacy, cybersecurity, interoperability, accessibility, scalability, supplier maturity, total cost, and support model.
  + Lead market scans, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, supplier due diligence, and fit-gap assessments.
  + Recommend whether to adopt, configure, integrate, scale, defer, or reject proposed solutions based on documented evidence.
  + Prevent technology-led implementations by confirming that each tool addresses a defined process need and has measurable success criteria.
* **Establish Digital Quality governance and assurance**
  + Define decision rights, design principles, architecture guardrails, stage gates, risk criteria, and governance forums for the Digital Quality portfolio.
  + Apply risk-based lifecycle assurance based on intended use and process risk, including requirements, supplier evidence, testing, traceability, release, change control, periodic review, and retirement.
  + Set governance for AI-enabled Quality solutions, including approved use cases, human oversight, data provenance, model performance, explainability, monitoring, drift, retraining, and accountability for decisions.
  + Ensure electronic records, signatures, audit trails, integrations, master data, and reporting controls meet applicable regulatory and company expectations.
* **Drive implementation, adoption, and value realization**
  + Provide Quality leadership through product selection, design, configuration, testing, deployment, stabilization, and continuous improvement.
  + Lead stakeholder engagement, communications, training, readiness assessments, and adoption measurement across global functions and sites.
  + Monitor solution performance, incidents, compliance signals, user feedback, benefits, and emerging risks throughout the lifecycle.
  + Manage portfolio risks, dependencies, budgets, resource needs, suppliers, and executive reporting.
* **Develop organizational capability**
  + Build digital literacy, process-mapping capability, product-management practices, and risk-based assurance skills across Quality.
  + Lead and develop internal staff and cross-functional teams; engage external specialists when needed.
  + Represent Quality in enterprise digital, data, AI, architecture, cybersecurity, and investment forums.
  + Monitor evolving regulations, industry practices, and emerging technologies and translate them into practical Quality standards and roadmaps.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. Please see the following for the qualifications and skills we seek for this role.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with at least 10 years of relevant experience in Digital Quality, Quality systems, digital transformation, computer system assurance or validation, process excellence, product management, or a related discipline.
* Experience in the biopharmaceutical, medical device, or another highly regulated life-sciences environment.

Atlantic Constructors offers competitive benefits, for more information check out our comprehensive list on our website. ACIBuilds.com

**Role Overview:**
==================

The Director of Offsite Production is responsible for the leadership, performance, and continued growth of offsite production across company facilities. The role oversees carbon and stainless steel pipe fabrication and non-volumetric prefabrication and manufacturing, including pipe racks, equipment skids, supports, frames, and multi-trade assemblies. The Director establishes the operating systems, production standards, capacity, and cross-functional coordination required to deliver safe, compliant, high-quality work on schedule.

This leader is accountable for implementing improvements that increase production capacity, labor productivity, throughput, and schedule reliability. The Director will implement and sustain Lean manufacturing methodologies, eliminate waste and production constraints, reduce rework, and create repeatable processes that support scalable offsite manufacturing. The position works closely with Estimating, Engineering, VDC, Procurement, Project Management, Quality, Safety, and field operations to align production with project and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Offsite Production Leadership**
---------------------------------

* Provide enterprise leadership for pipe fabrication, prefabrication, and manufacturing operations across company facilities and approved external production partners.
* Translate backlog, project schedules, and sales forecasts into capacity plans, staffing requirements, production priorities, and facility needs.
* Establish a consistent operating cadence for production planning, readiness reviews, constraint management, performance reporting, and executive escalation.
* Develop scalable operating standards that support growth while maintaining safety, quality, cost control, and predictable delivery performance.
* Coordinate work across facilities to balance demand, available labor, equipment, and production capability.

**Pipe Fabrication Operations**
-------------------------------

* Direct carbon and stainless steel pipe fabrication operations, including material receiving, cutting, beveling, fit-up, welding, inspection, testing, coating coordination, staging, and shipment.
* Ensure spool sequencing, production release, shop loading, and work packaging align with approved drawings, project priorities, and field installation requirements.
* Maintain compliance with applicable codes, specifications, welding procedures, ASME and AWS requirements, customer quality plans, and company standards.
* Improve material traceability, weld documentation, inspection records, testing status, and turnover packages for fabricated systems.

**Prefabrication and Manufacturing Operations**
-----------------------------------------------

* Lead production of non-volumetric prefabricated assemblies, including pipe racks, equipment skids, structural supports, frames, and multi-trade assemblies.
* Develop repeatable production cells, workstations, tooling, fixtures, travelers, and assembly sequences that improve flow and reduce variation.
* Ensure manufacturing plans account for structural, mechanical, electrical, controls, insulation, coatings, testing, preservation, packaging, and logistics requirements, as applicable.
* Support the transition of first-of-a-kind work into stable, repeatable production through lessons learned, standardized design, and controlled process updates.

**Production Planning and Readiness**
-------------------------------------

* Establish production-readiness criteria to confirm approved drawings, bills of material, work instructions, quality requirements, tooling, materials, and labor are available before work is released.
* Partner with Engineering and VDC to improve constructability, spool and assembly breakdown, drawing release sequencing, and design for manufacturing and assembly.
* Coordinate with Procurement and material-control teams to maintain visibility to shortages, supplier commitments, receiving status, kitting, and point-of-use material availability.
* Identify production constraints early, assign recovery actions, and communicate schedule or capacity risks to Project Management and executive leadership.
* Maintain production schedules that clearly identify priorities, dependencies, resource loading, planned output, and required shipment dates.

**Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement**
-------------------------------------------------

* Lead continuous-improvement initiatives that increase production capacity, labor productivity, throughput, and schedule reliability across all offsite operations.
* Implement and sustain Lean manufacturing methodologies, including 5S, standard work, value-stream mapping, visual management, cellular production, daily tiered accountability, Kaizen events, mistake-proofing, and continuous-flow principles.
* Evaluate workflows, facility layouts, material movement, staffing, tooling, and equipment utilization to identify and eliminate bottlenecks, waste, waiting, excess handling, rework, and other non-value-added activity.
* Use time studies, cycle-time analysis, workload balancing, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving to improve production performance and reduce manufacturing lead time.
* Develop and maintain standard work instructions and repeatable manufacturing processes that improve safety, quality, training effectiveness, and output predictability.
* Lead initiatives to reduce setup and changeover time, control work in process, improve material flow, and increase productive labor utilization.
* Maintain an improvement pipeline with defined owners, target benefits, implementation dates, and verified results; ensure completed improvements are standardized and sustained.
* Evaluate and implement automation, machinery, software, tooling, and manufacturing technologies that improve safety, quality, efficiency, and capacity.

**Throughput Capacity and Performance Management**
--------------------------------------------------

* Establish production targets and capacity models based on takt time, cycle time, labor availability, equipment constraints, facility limits, and project demand.
* Track and improve key performance indicators such as safety performance, labor hours per spool or assembly, plan attainment, throughput, work in process, first-pass yield, rework, equipment utilization, and on-time completion and shipment.
* Develop visual dashboards and tiered performance reviews that provide timely, accurate information to supervisors, project teams, and executive leadership.
* Analyze performance gaps, determine root causes, implement corrective and preventive actions, and verify that results are sustained.
* Use production data to validate estimating assumptions, workforce plans, capital investments, and future capacity requirements.

**Supplier and External Fabrication Partner Management**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Qualify, onboard, and manage third-party fabrication and manufacturing partners when additional capacity or specialized capability is required.
* Define scopes of work, quality requirements, documentation, inspection points, schedule expectations, material responsibilities, and delivery requirements for outsourced work.
* Monitor supplier performance for safety, quality, responsiveness, cost, schedule adherence, and corrective-action closure.
* Coordinate external production with internal Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Project Management, and logistics teams.

**Estimating and Preconstruction Support**
------------------------------------------

* Support Estimating and Preconstruction with production strategies, labor assumptions, production rates, facility requirements, tooling, equipment, subcontract capacity, and logistics considerations.
* Review proposed scope, drawings, specifications, and schedules to identify production risks, constructability issues, testing requirements, and opportunities for prefabrication or standardization.
* Provide fact-based labor and throughput data to improve estimate accuracy and establish achievable production commitments.
* Participate in make-or-buy decisions and recommend the most effective production approach based on capability, capacity, cost, risk, and schedule.

**Quality Safety and Delivery**
-------------------------------

* Promote a production culture in which safety, quality, and operational discipline are built into the process and are never traded for output.
* Partner with Safety and Quality leaders to establish training, inspections, hold points, audits, nonconformance controls, and corrective-action processes.
* Ensure completed work is inspected, tested, documented, preserved, packaged, and released in accordance with project and company requirements.
* Drive reduction of defects, weld repairs, material damage, punch-list items, field rework, and incomplete turnover documentation.
* Coordinate staging, loading, transportation readiness, and shipment sequencing to support safe handling and efficient field installation.

**Team Leadership and Development**
-----------------------------------

* Build and lead an accountable organization of production managers, superintendents, supervisors, planners, coordinators, and skilled craft professionals.
* Define roles, decision rights, staffing plans, performance expectations, and development paths for the offsite production team.
* Train leaders and production personnel in Lean principles, standard work, problem-solving, root-cause analysis, visual management, and data-driven decision-making.
* Develop succession plans and cross-training programs that increase workforce flexibility and reduce dependency on single points of knowledge.
* Create a culture of ownership, urgency, teamwork, continuous improvement, and respect for people.

**Qualifications and Experience**
=================================

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, manufacturing, operations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Ten or more years of progressive experience in fabrication, prefabrication, manufacturing, construction operations, or a closely related production environment, including significant leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated success improving production throughput, labor productivity, quality, schedule performance, and operating discipline.
* Practical experience implementing Lean manufacturing or continuous-improvement systems in a production environment.
* Strong understanding of pipe fabrication, welding, structural fabrication, production planning, material control, quality systems, and shop operations.
* Ability to build capacity plans, interpret production data, identify constraints, and translate performance information into corrective action.
* Experience coordinating with Estimating, Engineering, VDC, Procurement, Project Management, Quality, Safety, suppliers, and field teams.
* Strong leadership, communication, organizational, financial, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple facilities and competing priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent formal training in Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement.
* Experience with ASME, AWS, weld-quality programs, fabrication codes, and customer-specific quality requirements.
* Experience with production-planning, ERP, manufacturing execution, scheduling, and performance-dashboard systems.
* Working knowledge of fabrication and detailing platforms such as Stratus, Tekla, SpoolFab, or comparable systems.
* Experience establishing or expanding multi-facility prefabrication and manufacturing operations.
* Experience implementing automation, advanced tooling, production-line design, and capital improvement projects

existing_roles.description:
**About Tutor**
---------------

We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business.

Tutor Intelligence is changing that.

Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence.

Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.

Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

**The Role**
------------

As Head of Technical Operations, you’ll own manufacturing, supply chain, quality, field service and robot operations. We build hundreds of robots a year today and need to build a lot more. You’ll own how we get there, including the teams, suppliers and facilities, and work closely with engineering along the way.

You’ll report to the CTO. This is an onsite role in Watertown, MA.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Scaling production from hundreds of robots a year to many more
* Manufacturing, supply chain, quality, field service and robot operations
* The teams, suppliers and facilities behind production
* A close partnership with engineering

**Requirements**
----------------

* Ran manufacturing or operations at a company that builds complex hardware in volume
* Built an operations function and hired the people who run it
* Been responsible for a fleet of products in the field, including service and support
* Sets clear targets and hires well
* Comfortable on a factory floor

**Nice to have:**

* Robotics, or other products that combine hardware and software
* Experience with contract manufacturers
* Experience with quality systems

**What to Expect**
------------------

We want you to know exactly what to expect. Here’s what our interview process typically looks like:

* **Recruiter interview:** A conversation with a member of our Recruiting team about your background and what you’re looking for.
* **Hiring manager interview:** A deeper conversation with the hiring manager about the role and your experience.
* **Onsite:** A presentation with the team, 1:1s with key team members, and a tour of our facility.

Some roles include additional steps, such as a technical assessment or take-home exercise. If yours does, we’ll let you know up front. Throughout the process, we’ll aim to keep you updated at each step as quickly as possible.

**Why Tutor?**
--------------

Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable.

Our team of 160+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.

**Benefits**
------------

We take care of our team so they can do their best work. At Tutor, you’ll get:

* Fully employer-covered health insurance, so you’re protected without the premium.
* A managed 401(k) to help you plan for the future.
* Generous time off: unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full-time salaried employees, and 16+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees.
* Regular in-office meals and team social events throughout the year.

As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond.

Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

Compensation Range: $250K - $350K

What you'll do:  
  
Lead Cross-Department Initiatives

* Lead major initiatives that improve processes across departments, especially where work, systems, and ownership break down between teams.
* Frame ambiguous problems, define the outcome, and work backward into a solution that teams actually adopt.
* Lead on-site discovery with leaders and frontline teams to understand how work really gets done.

Transform Workforce Management

* Lead the redesign of how we schedule, staff, and manage our hourly warehouse teams, starting from what the business needs to achieve.
* Pilot solutions in one fulfillment center and scale what works across our network.
* Track the outcomes that matter, such as labor cost, staffing coverage, and retention.

Drive Continuous Improvement

* Help the whole organization work better, improving quality, speed, and the employee and merchant experience, not just cost.
* Spot recurring friction across teams, prioritize the biggest opportunities, and help teams adopt improvements that last.
* Make structured problem solving a habit at every level of the organization.

Strengthen Our Governance

* Support the organization as it matures how it sets priorities, makes decisions, and follows through on commitments.
* Partner with leaders to build governance practices that fit how each team works rather than imposing one structure.
* Bring clear analysis and decision materials to executive discussions.

Analyze, Build, and Drive Adoption

Reporting directly to the VP of Global Operations with a dotted-line relationship to the Vice President & General Manager (VPGM) of the Chillers business unit, this leader has direct operational responsibility for all global chiller manufacturing plants.

Each global chiller facility holds full SQDC (Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost) execution accountability. To drive self-sufficient, world-class execution at the plant level, the Director of Operations – Chillers will lead a comprehensive, multi-functional organization where each plant team includes dedicated Safety, Quality, Materials, and Manufacturing Operations resources.

As an integral member of the Global Operations team, this individual operates as an influential peer to Supply Chain (partnering to enable global Supply Chain and SIOP execution) and Materials (partnering to enable Materials management and Localized Procurement strategies), as well as the broader Global Operations leadership team. By bridging global functional capabilities with plant-level execution and business unit strategy, the Director of Operations – Chillers will drive rapid operational transformation, capacity expansion, and sustainable business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Global Plant Leadership & SQDC Execution Accountability**

* Hold direct operational oversight and P&L/conversion cost accountability for all global chiller manufacturing facilities.
* Drive rigorousSQDC (Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost) daily management and execution across every chiller site:

* **Safety:** Champion a zero-injury culture, ensuring proactive EHS compliance, ergonomic improvements, and behavioral safety leadership across all plants.
* **Quality:** Ensure zero-defect manufacturing standards, robust quality management systems, customer compliance, and rapid root-cause corrective actions.
* **Delivery:** Achieve industry-leading on-time delivery (OTD) and lead-time competitiveness through effective line balancing, capacity tracking, and constraint management.
* **Cost:** Optimize direct and indirect labor productivity, overhead absorption, scrap reduction, and continuous conversion cost improvements.
